title: Senior Software Engineer - DevOps
description:
Rapid7 is a publicly traded cybersecurity company headquartered in Boston, MA, with 17 offices around the world. As we expand our global footprint into India and build out our Product & Engineering teams in Pune, we are seeking a Senior Platform Operations Engineer. In this role, you will own the technical direction of our platform, driving end-to-end operational initiatives, leveraging cutting-edge technologies, and helping establish our foundational engineering presence in the region.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our Product and Engineering team builds award-winning solutions on the Insight platform to help over 10,000 global organizations assess risk, detect threats, and automate security programs. Working with best-in-class technology, leading-edge research, and broad strategic expertise, our global teams continuously innovate to deliver a cohesive, highly reliable security platform.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Platform Operations Engineer, your primary responsibility will be to set the technical direction for how we operate, secure, and scale our platform, with a focus on our FedRAMP authorized environment. Specifically, your focus will be to:
  
  

* Define the architecture, standards, and tooling strategy for our platform infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational automation.
* Lead platform operations for our FedRAMP environment in-house, taking ownership of existing systems and determining what to retain, rebuild, or retire.
* Drive continuous improvements to service reliability, availability, and MTTR across services through incident response leadership and post-incident reviews.
* Design and build internal automation that improves the efficiency, reliability, and security of microservice operations and deployments.
* Partner across product engineering, security, and compliance teams to ensure platform scaling meets strict regulatory and availability requirements.
* Mentor engineers across the team to raise the technical bar through structured design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

**The Skills And Qualities You'll Bring Include**

* Proven track record with 6+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering, including hands-on experience operating cloud production infrastructure at scale across AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Strong proficiency in Linux system administration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting alongside advanced container orchestration using Kubernetes and Docker.
* Proficiency in Python, Go, or equivalent programming languages is required.
* Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, including module design and state management at scale.
* Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring tooling such as Grafana or Prometheus, including defining SLOs and alerting strategies.
* Familiarity with agentic development practices using modern tools, GitOps practices, Ansible, and automated CI/CD pipeline management.
* Direct experience working within or alongside FedRAMP authorized cloud environments and familiarity with continuous monitoring compliance obligations.
* Capability for Strategic Doing by taking complex, ambiguous platform challenges and returning a clear execution plan, sequencing, and evaluated trade-offs with minimal direction.
* Personal Accountability for establishing clear operational ownership, driving system reliability, and taking responsibility for platform availability outcomes.
* Ability for Navigating Change & Ambiguity while leading infrastructure migrations, platform transitions, or vendor-to-in-house system handovers.
* Commitment to Cross-Functional Collaboration by building global networks across engineering, security, and product teams to deliver sustainable platform improvements.
* Strong communication skills to convey technical objectives and rationale clearly across teams while placing customer needs at the forefront of decision-making.
* Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That's because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don't be shy - apply today.
  
  
**About Rapid7**
At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.
  
  
Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.

title: AWS DEVOPS ENGINEERS
description:

Integrate observability (monitoring, logging, alerting) using Dynatrace, Datadog or Prometheus/Grafana

Manage event streaming and messaging systems: Kafka, AWS MSK clusters, SQS

Lead incident troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and mentor junior engineers

Required Skills:

Strong hands-on experience with Amazon EKS, including production upgrades

Strong hands-on experience on Terraform.

Strong AWS experience: VPC, Route53, IAM, EC2, ALB

Strong Kubernetes experience: architecture, troubleshooting, Ingress, Istio

Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler, HPA, KEDA

DR setup and Blue-Green deployments

ArgoCD, Argo Rollouts, GitOps

CI/CD with GitHub Actions / Harness / Jenkins

Observability tools: Dynatrace / Datadog / Prometheus

Kafka / MSK / SQS

Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred), Helm, scripting in Bash/Python

Nice to Have:

AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, CKA / CKAD, Terraform Associate.

Experience with multi-account AWS setups and cost optimization

Relevant job titles to search: Senior DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, AWS Cloud Engineer, Kubernetes Engineer.

Please prioritize profiles showing hands-on EKS, AWS services and Kafka/MSK work in production.

title: Junior AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a skilled AWS DevOps Engineer with 3+ years of experience in DevOps and cloudinfrastructure management. The candidate will work closely with our existing DevOps team to maintainand improve AWS production environments, support application deployments, troubleshoot infrastructureissues, and ensure system reliability, security, and performance.

AWS DevOps Engineer | 3+ Years Experience Page 2

title: MS-AI4AI-PlatformEngineering-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title:**
AI Platform Engineering Manager
  
  
**Role Overview:**
EY GDS's Managed Services “AI for AI” team is looking for an
**AI Platform Engineering Manager**
to own the deployment, scaling, and reliability of our agentic AI solutions across a complex, hybrid infrastructure landscape — multi-cloud, on-prem, and hosted model environments. You'll lead a team of engineers responsible for turning AI prototypes into resilient, enterprise-grade platforms that run globally, securely, and cost-effectively.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, and agentic systems architecture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own platform deployment for agentic AI solutions across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, as well as on-prem and hybrid-hosted model environments (open-source and proprietary LLMs).
* Design and manage CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for model deployment, versioning, rollback, and continuous evaluation at scale.
* Architect for scale and resilience — ensuring platforms reliably serve 100,000+ concurrent users globally with strong uptime, latency, and cost-efficiency targets.
* Lead a team of platform/infrastructure engineers, setting technical direction, mentoring, and managing delivery timelines.
* Partner cross-functionally with AI Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Responsible AI leads, and Product Design to translate agentic workflows into production-ready systems.
* Manage model-hosting strategy, including trade-offs between hosted APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), self-hosted open-source models, and on-prem deployments for data residency/compliance needs.
* Build observability and monitoring for agentic systems — tracing, logging, cost monitoring, drift detection, and performance dashboards.
* Drive security, compliance, and governance of AI infrastructure in collaboration with Responsible AI and InfoSec teams, particularly given enterprise/regulated-client contexts (tax, cybersecurity, supply chain data).
* Optimize infrastructure cost and performance, balancing GPU/compute resource allocation across cloud and on-prem environments.
* Contribute to platform strategy and roadmap, advising leadership on build-vs-buy decisions, emerging tools, and infrastructure investments.

**Experience**
**What We're Looking For**

* 5–8 years in platform engineering, infrastructure/DevOps, SRE, or MLOps roles, with at least 2+ years working on AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production.
* Demonstrated experience deploying and scaling software/AI platforms across multiple cloud providers (AWS,Azure, GCP) and in on-prem/hybrid environments.
* Experience deploying and managing both hosted LLM APIs and self-hosted/open-source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) in production.
* Experience building or operating agentic AI systems or complex multi-step AI workflows is highly preferred.
* Prior experience managing or leading a team of engineers.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation).
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization (Docker), and orchestration at scale.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
* Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps tooling
* Understanding of model-hosting economics, GPU resource management, and inference optimization techniques (quantization, batching, caching).
* Working knowledge of enterprise security, data residency, and compliance requirements in regulated industries.
* Proficiency in at least one major programming language (Python strongly preferred; Go or Java a plus)

**Soft Skills / Leadership**

* Proven ability to lead engineering teams in fast-paced, ambiguous, build-from-scratch environments.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — comfortable working with Data SMEs, Product, Responsible AI, and business stakeholders.
* Clear communicator who can translate technical trade-offs into business impact for non-technical leadership.
* Comfortable operating in a "zero to one" environment — building platform foundations rather than maintaining existing ones.

**What We Offer:**

* A leadership position within a globally recognized team at the cutting edge of AI/ML innovation, providing the opportunity to work on transformative projects with significant impact.
* Access to an extensive network of professionals and resources across the globe, fostering an environment conducive to continuous learning and career advancement.
* A diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates individuality and encourages the expression of ideas, facilitating collaborative team efforts and personal growth.
* Comprehensive support and guidance to develop into a transformative leader, equipped to navigate and excel in today's rapidly evolving technological landscape.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Overview**

The Database & Platform Engineering team is responsible for building and operating secure, scalable, highly available, and automated database platforms that support Mastercard's mission-critical payment systems. DevOps & SRE Lead – JFrog Artifactory SME (12+ Years)
  
  
Mastercard
  
  
**Overview**
MSBX (Mastercard Secure Build Experience) is transforming how more than 11,000 software engineers build, test, and deliver software across Mastercard. Our mission is to provide a secure, resilient, and frictionless software delivery ecosystem, enabling engineers to focus on customer value rather than infrastructure complexity.
  
  
DevFlow is a cornerstone of this mission, modernizing Mastercard’s CI/CD ecosystem through secure, scalable, and cloud-ready engineering platforms. Artifactory is a critical part of this ecosystem, providing enterprise artifact management across on-premises, Azure, and AWS environments. DevFlow is built for enterprise scale, reliability, security, and developer trust.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of DevOps and SRE, providing technical ownership and operational excellence for the enterprise Artifactory platform across on-premises and cloud environments, including AWS and Azure.
  
  
The Role
  
  
As a Lead, you will provide technical leadership and end-to-end ownership of the JFrog Artifactory platform across on-premises, AWS, and Azure environments, covering platform architecture, engineering, reliability, security, automation, upgrades, and lifecycle management.
  
  
You will act as a hands-on Artifactory platform leader, designing, engineering, and operating enterprise Artifactory services across on-premises and cloud environments. You will drive platform standards, automation, operational resilience, and developer experience while ensuring Artifactory remains secure, scalable, highly available, and easy to consume.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Platform & CI/CD Leadership
  
  

* Lead the design, delivery, and evolution of enterprise JFrog Artifactory capabilities across on-premises, AWS, and Azure environments, with secondary responsibilities across SonarQube, Bitbucket, and broader CI/CD capabilities.

DevOps & Automation

○ Capacity, storage, and platform health
  
  
○ Backup, recovery, and disaster recovery readiness
  
  

* Partner on incident response, root cause analysis, and blameless postmortems, ensuring learnings are incorporated into platform improvements and automation.

Collaboration & Leadership

title: Senior Cloud Operations Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Assent empowers manufacturers and distributors with the intelligence to build sustainable products, meet global compliance requirements and drive better business outcomes.
  
  
At the center of our offering is the Assent Network, the industry’s most complete Product Intelligence Network, bringing together trusted parts and supplier intelligence, advanced AI and deep regulatory expertise to help organizations identify risk, make informed decisions and stay ahead of evolving requirements.
  
  
Trusted by more than 1,000 customers worldwide, Assent helps organizations stay ahead of evolving regulations across areas including responsible sourcing, human rights due diligence, PFAS reporting, Digital Product Passports, and other emerging requirements. Our platform empowers manufacturers to navigate change with confidence while building stronger supplier relationships and driving measurable business value.
  
  
With more than 1000 team members across India, North America, Malaysia, the European Union, and Kenya, Assent brings together global expertise, diverse perspectives, and a shared commitment to innovation. Our hybrid work model enables teams to collaborate across regions while staying connected to the communities where they live and work. As a certified B Corporation, we meet rigorous standards of social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability, reflecting our commitment to creating lasting value for our customers, our people, and the planet.
  
  
**People First. Technology Forward.**
Our commitment to People, Culture & Community (PCC) is rooted in building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team. We recruit and retain team members with a range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, while fostering a culture of belonging where all Assentees are respected, supported, and empowered to contribute.
  
  
As we continue to embed AI into how we work, we do so thoughtfully, enhancing human potential, supporting better decision-making, and prioritizing appropriate oversight, privacy, and fairness.
  
  
At Assent, we value your privacy and are committed to maintaining transparency in how we handle your personal information. As part of our talent acquisition and management processes, we may use AI technologies to support activities such as resume screening, candidate communication, and talent analytics.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
The Senior Cloud Operations Specialist is a senior technical owner for the stability, security, governance, and resilience of Assent's enterprise AWS environment and SaaS production systems. The role combines hands-on cloud operations with solution architecture, technical leadership, and sound risk-based decision making across a large multi-account AWS estate.
  
  
Working within the SaaS Product Infrastructure group, this individual partners with Engineering, Product, Corporate Security, and IT to design and operate secure, highly available cloud services. The successful candidate works independently at a high level, turns business and technical requirements into practical solutions, and constructively challenges decisions that introduce unnecessary risk, operational burden, or architectural debt.
  
  
This role follows a strict code-first and least-privilege operating model. Infrastructure changes are codified, peer-reviewed, and delivered through approved pipelines. Privileged access is exceptional, time-bound, auditable, and used only when required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architecture Technical Leadership and Decision Making**

* Lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable AWS solutions from initial requirements through production operation.
* Translate business, security, compliance, and operational requirements into architecture decisions, implementation plans, and reusable platform patterns.
* Evaluate technical options and make clear, risk-based recommendations that balance security, reliability, maintainability, delivery speed, and cost.
* Question assumptions and respectfully challenge designs or delivery approaches that conflict with enterprise standards, least-privilege principles, reliability objectives, or long-term platform health.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews, document key decisions and tradeoffs, and ensure operational readiness before production adoption.
* Act as a senior technical escalation point, lead complex infrastructure initiatives, and coach team members through design and operational decisions.

**AWS Platform Governance Identity and Privileged Access**

* Own and continuously improve Assent's AWS multi-account environment using AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, organizational units, account lifecycle controls, guardrails, and Service Control Policies.
* Architect and operate AWS IAM Identity Center, IAM roles and policies, permission sets, trust relationships, permission boundaries, federation, and cross-account access patterns.
* Apply least privilege by default. Ensure elevated access is approved, time-bound where supported, protected by strong authentication, logged, regularly reviewed, and separated from day-to-day identities.
* Maintain controlled break-glass access and prevent shared credentials, unmanaged access paths, unnecessary standing privilege, and unreviewed administrative changes.
* Lead account provisioning, compliance assessments, access reviews, drift detection, and remediation across the AWS organization.
* Partner with Corporate Security on identity governance, audit readiness, cloud control design, and the implementation of enterprise security requirements.

**Enterprise AWS Networking**

* Design, operate, and troubleshoot enterprise AWS network architectures across accounts and regions, including VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, network ACLs, and shared network services.
* Own connectivity and traffic-flow patterns using services such as Transit Gateway, VPC peering, PrivateLink, VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, API Gateway, and CloudFront.
* Design secure ingress, egress, segmentation, DNS, and service-to-service connectivity patterns using AWS Network Firewall, AWS WAF, VPC endpoints, flow logs, and centralized inspection where appropriate.
* Diagnose complex routing, name resolution, load-balancing, firewall, latency, and cross-account connectivity issues and drive permanent corrective action.
* Maintain current network diagrams, traffic-flow documentation, connectivity standards, and recovery procedures.

**Infrastructure as Code Automation and Delivery**

* Provision and govern AWS platform resources through Terraform using reusable modules, secure remote state, controlled workspaces, and maintainable multi-account patterns.
* Use GitHub Actions as the primary delivery mechanism for infrastructure and governance changes, with peer review, validation, security checks, approvals, and traceable deployment records.
* Uphold a no unmanaged changes standard. Use AWS console access only for approved operational needs, and codify or reconcile any necessary emergency change promptly.
* Build automation with Python, PowerShell, Bash, Lambda, Ansible, Semaphore, or similar tools to reduce manual effort, enforce consistency, and improve recovery time.
* Review infrastructure code and automation for security, reliability, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise standards.

**Cloud Operations Reliability and Incident Response**

* Operate and improve core AWS services across compute, containers, databases, storage, messaging, DNS, content delivery, security, and monitoring.
* Install, configure, secure, patch, and troubleshoot Linux and Windows workloads in cloud environments.
* Establish effective monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and automated remediation using CloudWatch, OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, New Relic, PagerDuty, or comparable platforms.
* Lead or support high-severity incident response, communicate clearly under pressure, restore service safely, and coordinate across technical and business teams.
* Conduct root-cause analysis and ensure corrective actions address underlying technical and process failures rather than only immediate symptoms.
* Participate in the on-call rotation and planned off-hours work required to support production infrastructure.

**Security Compliance Resilience and Operational Ownership**

* Maintain enterprise standards for encryption, key management, audit logging, configuration compliance, vulnerability remediation, and evidence collection using services such as KMS, CloudTrail, and AWS Config.
* Support internal and external audits and provide clear evidence of cloud controls, access governance, and operational processes.
* Design, implement, and test backup, business continuity, disaster recovery, and multi-region resilience capabilities.
* Create and maintain accurate documentation for cloud architecture, governance controls, operational procedures, automation workflows, and support handoffs.
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned platforms and initiatives, surface risks early, and follow decisions through implementation and operational acceptance.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Requirements**

* 7 or more years of relevant experience in cloud operations, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or systems administration, including substantial hands-on responsibility for enterprise AWS environments.
* Proven long-term ownership of a multi-account AWS organization using AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, and AWS IAM Identity Center.
* Deep experience with enterprise AWS governance, including organizational design, account provisioning, Service Control Policies, guardrails, configuration compliance, and drift remediation.
* Advanced knowledge of AWS identity and access management, including least privilege, privileged-access controls, federation, cross-account access, permission sets, IAM policies and roles, and emergency access practices.
* Strong AWS networking experience, including multi-account and multi-region network design, routing, DNS, load balancing, private connectivity, segmentation, and network security controls.
* Strong Terraform experience, including reusable modules, multi-account deployment patterns, secure remote state in Amazon S3, code review, testing, and lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure deployment, policy enforcement, and operational automation.
* Demonstrated ability to architect solutions and carry them through implementation, validation, documentation, and production support.
* Sound judgment in ambiguous or high-pressure situations, with the confidence to challenge proposals, explain risk clearly, and make defensible technical decisions.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Working knowledge of Linux and Windows administration in production cloud environments.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, security stakeholders, leadership, and vendors.
* Ability to work independently as part of a globally distributed team and to participate in on-call and planned off-hours work.
* University degree, college diploma, or equivalent practical experience.
* AWS certification at the Associate level or higher, or equivalent demonstrated enterprise AWS expertise.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Account Factory for Terraform or Customizations for AWS Control Tower.
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Advanced Networking Specialty, or Security Specialty certification.
* Experience with ECS or Fargate, EC2, RDS for PostgreSQL or SQL Server, S3, SQS, SNS, SES, Amazon MQ, API Gateway, CloudFront, and Route 53.
* Experience with enterprise configuration management and automation using Ansible, Semaphore, or comparable tooling.
* Experience with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, New Relic, PagerDuty, Datadog, SolarWinds DPA, or comparable observability and performance platforms
* Familiarity with Auth0 or other enterprise identity providers.
* Experience designing and testing disaster recovery across AWS accounts and regions.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS, regulated industries, or high-security cloud environments.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Assent**
**Wellness:**
We believe that you and your family’s well being is important. As a result, we offer vacation time that increases with tenure, comprehensive benefits packages (details vary by country), life leave days and more.
  
  
**Financial Benefits:**
It’s not all about the money – well, it’s a little about the money. We understand that financial health is important and we offer a competitive base salary, a corporate bonus program, retirement savings options and more.
  
  
**Life at Assent:**
There is purpose beyond your work. We provide our team members with flexible work options, volunteer days and opportunities to get involved in corporate giving initiatives.
  
  
**Lifelong Learning:**
At Assent, curiosity is not only valued but encouraged. You will receive professional development days that are available to you the day you start.
  
  
At Assent, we are committed to growing and sustaining an environment where our team members feel included, valued, and heard. Our diversity and equal opportunity practices are guided and championed by our Diversity and Inclusion Working Group and our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs).
  
  
Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion includes recruiting and retaining team members from diverse backgrounds and experiences, and fostering a culture of belonging where all team members are included, treated with dignity and respect, promoted on their merits, and placed in positions to contribute to business success.
  
  
If you require assistance or accommodation throughout any part of the interview and selection process, please contact talent@assent.com and we will be happy to help.
  
  
We use AI to support parts of our recruitment process, such as note-taking and initial shortlisting based on job-related qualifications. AI does not make hiring decisions. All candidates will speak with a real person, and final decisions are always made by our recruitment team.

or follow us on

LinkedIn

,


Facebook

, and


Instagram

.

 

CSE SRE – DBA Focus

**Job Description**

As a Software Dev Senior Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our Cloud-based services. You will define and enforce reliability standards, drive the adoption of SRE practices across engineering teams, and build the systems and tooling that keep our production infrastructure healthy. We follow a DevOps model: Development and Operations teams are integrated, and the SRE function acts as the reliability layer — setting Service Level Objectives, managing error alerts, and continuously reducing toil through engineering.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead on call response and triage – help design and lead the 24x7 response team for triage and rally engineering to address service degradation, facilitating process and communications along the way
* Define, publish, and continuously refine Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for all critical services, partnering with product and engineering leadership.
* Own the error management practices, including monitoring and alerting, and surfacing notable errors to the development team
* Lead the design and implementation of comprehensive observability platforms — metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing — to ensure full visibility into production systems.
* Drive toil reduction initiatives by identifying and automating repetitive, manual operational work, targeting measurable reduction in operational burden across teams.
* Design and execute chaos engineering programs to proactively uncover reliability weaknesses in our infrastructure and services before they impact customers.

* Lead blameless postmortem culture: facilitate incident retrospectives, extract systemic learnings, and track corrective action items to completion.
* Build and improve on-call incident response processes, runbooks, and escalation paths; manage and optimize on-call rotation health to prevent burnout.
* Collaborate with platform and application developers to bring new features and services into production using production-readiness reviews and launch checklists.
* Champion reliability engineering best practices across the organization, embedding SRE principles into the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor team members on SRE philosophy, technical decision-making, code reviews, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Participate in roadmap planning, identify areas of improvement, and perform technology evaluation and selection.

**Required:**

* 5+ years of experience in database scaling performance and reliability, connection pool optimization
* 5+ years of experience in database HA design and failover strategies
* 3+ years of hands-on Site Reliability Engineering experience, including ownership of SLOs and error budget management.
* 4+ years of experience with Cloud Platforms, GCP CloudSQL required.
* Experience with database capacity planning, load testing, and performance benchmarking at scale.
* Experience managing other database systems — PostgreSQL, Redis, Etc .
* CS Degree or equivalent experience.

**Preferred:**

* Familiarity with Google SRE principles and the concepts outlined in the Google SRE Book
* Understanding of the HTTP protocol and experience diagnosing distributed system latency issues.
* Experience with instrumentation and management of automated deployments.
* Experience resolving customer-facing production issues under time pressure.
* Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams
* Experience in infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK)
* Experience in scripting using Python, Shell, or a similar language.

description:

Senior Cloud Network Infrastructure Engineer
  
  
About Us:
  
  
Platform9: Private Clouds Made Easy
  
  
Platform9 is the leader in simplifying enterprise Private Clouds. Founded by a team of VMware cloud pioneers, we are dedicated to transforming IT operations. Our flagship product, Private Cloud Director, turns your existing hardware into a full-featured, future-ready private cloud. We innovate across what we build and how we deliver it, staying focused on a next-generation, open private cloud while holding ourselves to one standard: exceptional customer outcomes.
  
  
Enterprises are selecting Platform9 to replace legacy virtualization because it eliminates operational risk and complexity. Private Cloud Director is designed for the experienced infrastructure team, offering a familiar GUI experience for managing VMs and containers, seamless integration with your existing hardware and third-party storage, and critical enterprise features (HA/DR, scale, reliability) built-in. This enables IT teams to gain robust API control and a user experience they trust—rooted in customer obsession and an owner’s mindset. We share context quickly and candidly to keep decisions moving.
  
  
With over 30,000 nodes in production at some of the world’s largest enterprises, including Cloudera, EBSCO, Juniper Networks, and Rackspace, Platform9 is the proven path to achieving true vendor independence and operational consistency. We are an inclusive, globally distributed company backed by prominent investors, supported by a partner ecosystem of resellers, systems integrators, MSPs, and technology vendors committed to driving private cloud innovation and efficiency. Our values—innovation, customer obsession, ownership, radical candor, and excellence—guide how we build and support every deployment.
  
  
Position Summary:
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Cloud Network Infrastructure Engineer to join our cloud engineering team. The ideal candidate will design, deploy, operationalize, and maintain high-performance Software-Defined Network (SDN) architectures, bridging deep data center networking expertise with modern cloud-native telemetry, microservices, OpenStack environments, and Kubernetes-native application development. You will manage virtual switching platforms, overlay networking, and L2/L3 dynamic routing to ensure seamless connectivity and robust security across our private cloud infrastructure.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities:
  
  

* SDN & Virtual Switching: Architect, maintain, and optimize Open Virtual Switch (OVS) and Open Virtual Network (OVN) dataplanes. Manage OpenFlow pipelines and SDN controllers for automated flow control
* Cloud Infrastructure & Kubernetes: Deploy and operationalize OpenStack networking services (Neutron, Metadata Service) using OpenStack Ansible. Contribute to the development of cloud-native networking products, microservices, and controllers for our Kubernetes product ecosystem
* Overlay & Underlay Networking: Design, optimize, and troubleshoot overlay tunnels (VxLAN, GENEVE) and virtual networks (VLAN 802.1Q) running over high-throughput physical fabrics (L3 CLOS, LACP, MCT/vLAG)
* L2/L3 Routing & Switching: Implement and manage dynamic routing protocols (BGP, EVPN, OSPF) for WAN/DC interconnects, ECMP load balancing, and VRRP gateway redundancy
* Network Security: Secure network traffic across untrusted boundaries using IPsec VPNs (IKEv2, ESP). Configure stateful firewalls, connection tracking (Conntrack), and NAT rules using IPTables/Netfilter and NFTables
* Automation, Telemetry & Lifecycle Management: Build, test, and validate network topologies locally using Vagrant and hypervisors (KVM/QEMU) prior to production rollouts. Develop resources to handle platform upgrades, real-time streaming telemetry architectures (gRPC, ProtoBuf, Kafka), and network lifecycle management

Technical Requirements & Skill Stack:
  
  

* Cloud & Virtualization Platforms: OpenStack (Neutron, Nova, Metadata Service), OpenStack Ansible, KVM/QEMU, DevStack
* Software-Defined Networking (SDN): Open vSwitch (OVS), Open Virtual Network (OVN), OpenFlow, SDN Controllers
* Overlay & Encapsulation: VxLAN, GENEVE, VLAN (802.1Q)
* L2/L3 Protocols & Data Center: BGP, EVPN, OSPF, ECMP, VRRP, IPv4/IPv6, ARP/NDP, Ethernet (802.3), STP/RSTP, L3 CLOS, LACP, MCT/vLAG
* Cloud-Native & Telemetry: Kubernetes, Docker, Kubernetes Controllers, Operator SDK, CRDs, gRPC, Protocol Buffers, Kafka, Numaflow
* Security & Packet Inspection: IPsec (IKEv2, ESP), IPTables/Netfilter, NFTables, Conntrack
* DevOps, Automation & Languages: Golang (Go), Python, C, Vagrant, Ansible, Linux CLI, Bash, CI/CD (Jenkins, Git), OpenAPI / REST APIs

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field with 8–15 years of software development and infrastructure experience across cloud engineering, telecommunications, or large-scale data center environments
* Deep expertise in Linux networking concepts, packet path traversal, and kernel-level networking subsystems
* Proven track record with production OpenStack deployments using OVN/OVS as the default networking backend
* Strong proficiency in Golang, Python, or C with hands-on experience in white-box switch network management applications
* Self-starter with strong problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and excellent written/verbal communication in dynamic environments

To succeed in this role, you will need to be a team player with a strong sense of ownership for your work and a passion for working in a data-driven organization.
  
  
Benefits and Perks:
  
  
Employees today are looking for companies that truly care and recognise their whole person. Platform9's benefits and perks have been carefully designed to ensure that we take care of an employee's emotions and physical well-being. Many of our benefits extend to families, who form a significant part of our well-being at work
  
  
Please note that benefits change by country.
  
  

* Competitive Compensation and Equity
* Medical Healthcare for you and your family

title: Tech Manager, Cloud Operations, Actimize
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
**So, what’s the role all about?**
We are looking for a technically strong and delivery-focused Technical Manager to lead a team of CloudOps Delivery Engineers responsible for post go-live operations of cloud-based applications. This role is critical in ensuring timely upgrades, defect resolution, and performance enhancements across our customer environments. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and customers to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What you will be doing?**

* Team Leadership & Execution

+ Lead and mentor a team of CloudOps Delivery Engineers focused on post go-live activities.
+ Ensure high-quality execution of upgrades, patches, and fixes across customer environments.
+ Promote a culture of ownership, agility, and technical excellence.

* Technical Delivery

+ Oversee upgrades to the latest product versions across the customer base.
+ Oversee the deployment of changes, enhancements and fixes for performance, security, and stability.
+ Ensure adherence to change management and CAB processes.
+ Drive automation and standardization of delivery workflows.
+ Assess technical feasibility and impact of proposed changes and upgrades across diverse customer environments.
+ Define and maintain delivery playbooks and low-level execution plans to support consistent and scalable delivery.
+ Collaborate with Program Managers to support project planning, effort estimation, and resource allocation.
+ Identify risks and dependencies early in the delivery lifecycle and propose mitigation strategies.

* Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

+ Work closely with CloudOps Delivery Program Managers to align on delivery plans, priorities, pipeline and backlog management.
+ Collaborate with internal teams including AppOps, DevOps, Customer Support, Professional Services and R&D to resolve issues and improve delivery outcomes.
+ Support customer-facing teams in ensuring smooth post go-live operations.

* Operational Excellence

+ Drive automation, standardization, and scalability of delivery processes.
+ Track and report on delivery KPIs including upgrade success rates, defect resolution times, and customer impact.
+ Identify and implement improvements to reduce manual effort and increase reliability.

**Have you got what it takes?**

* 10+ years of experience in Application Implementation, Cloud Operations or Infrastructure Engineering.
* 5+ years in a technical leadership or management role.
* Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation tools (Terraform, Ansible, etc.).
* Solid understanding of change management, version control, and configuration management.
* Experience working in a SaaS or Enterprise software environment.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, global delivery environment, including off-hours and weekend support when needed.
* Preferred Skills:

+ Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, CKA Kubernetes).
+ Familiarity with ITIL or other service management frameworks.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
+ Experience with customer-facing delivery or support roles.

**What’s in it for you?**
Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!
  
  
**Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!**
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

11456

(NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

**AI Strategic Architect**
SFL Scientific, a Deloitte Business practice brings together several key capabilities to architect integrated programs that transform our clients' businesses, including Strategic Growth Transformation, Transformation Strategy & Design, Technology Strategy & Business Transformation, and AI & Data Strategy.
  
  
Professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices, using the latest state-of-the-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design and implement novel solutions that drive value.
  
  
We are hiring AI Strategic Architects to support and lead development, deployment, and maintenance of novel AI solutions and cloud architectures across healthcare, manufacturing, energy, retail, finance, and other sectors.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As an AI Strategic Architect at SFL Scientific, a Deloitte Business, you’ll work with a cross-functional strategy and AI team to bring solutions to life.
  
  
We seek individuals with a strategic mindset for planning and implementing AI systems for large-scale organizations on both on-prem and cloud infrastructure.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing, deploying, benchmarking, and scaling solutions from test environments to global production, impacting millions. Key tasks also include gathering and understanding business requirements, identification of performance gaps, and the design and implementation of scalable solutions in the client’s environment.
  
  
Successful candidates will work with non-technical stakeholders, IT teams, and existing solution teams to translate requirements into a technical design, handling both strategic design and implementation tasks, to drive value for our clients.
  
  
**Design & Planning**
:
  
  

* Work directly with clients, stakeholders and user groups to understand requirements and communicate technical decisions and trade-offs.
* Interact with client IT teams to ensure solutions are compatible with their requirements and that deployment schedules are timely, efficient and well-coordinated between teams.
* Integrate with a broader delivery team to design technical specifications that outline the resources, functions, interfaces and architecture of a scaled solution applicable to the common hyperscalers (AWS, GSP, Azure).
* Assess small scale functional AI solutions and determine performance gaps, required enhancements and technical solutions for deploying those solutions at scale - this spans data security, latency considerations, large concurrent workloads, performance expectations, user requirements.
* Assist in documentation required for successful product deployment, this could include sustain processes, user guides, interface schematics etc.

**Execution**
:
  
  

* Sprint planning and implementation of technical architectures, this would include implementing CICD pipelines, deploying cloud resources, implementing Kubernetes based deployments, networking across cloud resources, ETL pipelines.
* Design and development of web-based UI’s.
* Implementation and testing of core application enhancements with a focus on AI workloads (ex. RAG applications, multi-agent workloads, AI modeling enhancements).

**The Team**
SFL Scientific, a Deloitte Business, is a data science professional services practice focused on strategy, technology, and solving business challenges with Artificial Intelligence (AI). The team has a proven track record serving large, market-leading organizations in the private and public sectors, successfully delivering high-quality, novel and complex projects, and offering deep domain and scientific capabilities. Made up of experienced AI strategists, data scientists, and AI engineers, they serve as trusted advisors to executives, helping them understand and evaluate new and essential areas for AI investment and identify unique opportunities to transform their businesses.
  
  
**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant STEM Field (ex. Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics)
* 5+ years of experience working in data science, data engineering, software engineering, and/or MLOps.
* Experience with cloud deployment (AWS, Azure, GCP), such as designing, building, and scaling using cloud tools such as AWS SageMaker or Azure ML Studio.
* 5+ years working with core cloud application development tools & services (ex. Kubernetes, docker, Argo CD, Jenkins, Terraform, DVC, MLFlow, Kubeflow, FastAPI, ADO).
* 3+ years’ experience with implementing application with genAI toolsets (ex. Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, OpenLLM, vLLM, NIM, NEMO, LangFuse)

**#FY27ReferralCampaign**

* Graduate level degree (Masters/PhD) or Undergraduate level degree (B.Tech) in relevant STEM field (Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering etc.) from premier colleges such as IIT, BITS, NIT, and IISC
* 3+ years of experience in AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis in the major data modalities from NLP, time-series analysis, computer vision, to graph models with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models.
* 3+ years of experience in core programming languages and data science packages (Python, Keras, Tensorflow, PyTorch, Pandas, Scikit-learn, etc.)
* Experience in designing robust software engineering solutions.
* Demonstrated excellence in verbal and written communication skills and experience in a client-facing or team management role.
* Highly proficient written and verbal skills to support briefings, proposals, technical sprint plans, solution reports, progress updates, and executive presentations.
* 2+ years’ experience designing and developing web-based UI’s using React.
* 2+ years’ experience with data tools and databases (ex. MongoDB, RDS) and vector databases (ex. Milvus, ChromaDB, ElasticSearch, Pinecone).
* 2+ years’ experience with scripting languages with a heavy emphasis on python.

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

title: DevOps Engineer (WordPress & Hosting)
description:
Brainstorm Force is a product-based software company that builds WordPress products and SaaS applications, while also hosting WordPress production sites for customers. We are looking for a skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer with 2–3 years of experience to help maintain the performance, security, availability, and scalability of our infrastructure.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing customer hosting environments on cPanel, WordPress/PHP servers running on Nginx and LiteSpeed, and Laravel and Next.js SaaS applications deployed on bare-metal servers and VPS environments. You will also leverage AI tools like Claude in your day-to-day work to troubleshoot issues, build automation, and document solutions more efficiently, while ensuring that every production change is reliable, secure, and well-tested.

**Why You’ll Love Working With Us:**

* Remote work
* Competitive pay
* Flexible working hours
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Allowances for setting up workspace
* Excellent work-life balance
* Career growth opportunities

**What you’ll be doing:**

**WordPress/PHP servers:**

* Run and tune Nginx + PHP-FPM and LiteSpeed/OpenLiteSpeed stacks with MySQL/MariaDB and Redis.
* Fix slow sites, 5xx errors, memory exhaustion and database bottlenecks.

**SaaS infrastructure:**

* Deploy and maintain Laravel (queues, Horizon/Supervisor, schedulers) and Next.js (Node/PM2) apps on bare metal and VPS.
* Run zero-downtime deployments with clear rollback plans.

**Customer hosting (cPanel/WHM):**

* Maintain the servers that host our customers’ production WordPress sites.
* Handle account setup and migrations, PHP version management, resource limits, malware cleanup and email deliverability.
* Diagnose and fix server-level issues on customer sites.

**Edge and networking:**

* Own DNS, Cloudflare (WAF, caching rules, SSL modes), CDN setup and load balancing across our services.
* Improve performance through CDN and caching (Cloudflare, server-side caching, Redis object cache).

**Cloud services and reliability:**

* Manage AWS S3 storage, SES email sending and IAM access, following least-privilege practices.
* Run monitoring, alerting, backups with tested restores, patching, SSH hardening, firewalls and SSL/TLS certificates.
* Respond to incidents and write clear root-cause reports.
* Document infrastructure and fixes so the team can work from shared runbooks, and work with development teams to scale applications and improve performance.

**AI-assisted operations:**

* Use Claude to troubleshoot, write scripts and Ansible playbooks, review configs and keep runbooks current.
* Automate routine tasks with shell scripting, Ansible and other tools.
* Check AI output before running it, and never share customer data or credentials with it.

**You must have these skills:​**

* 2–3 years working on Linux production servers over SSH.
* Hosted and maintained WordPress/PHP sites at server level: reading logs, fixing 500/502 errors, slow sites, PHP and memory issues.
* Working knowledge of DNS, Cloudflare/CDN, SSL, and the basics of how load balancing works.
* MySQL/MariaDB basics: backups, restores, finding slow queries.
* Redis working knowledge: installing and securing it (no public exposure, password/ACL), WordPress object caching, Laravel cache/queue/session use, and basic memory and eviction settings.
* Working knowledge of core AWS services:
* S3: buckets, access policies, storing backups and assets, lifecycle rules
* SES: domain verification, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, handling bounces and complaints, leaving the sandbox
* IAM: users vs. roles, least-privilege policies, access keys and why to avoid long-lived ones
* Uses Claude or similar AI tools in daily technical work, and checks the output before running it.

**Good-to-Have skills:**

* cPanel/WHM server administration or shared-hosting infrastructure experience
* LiteSpeed/OpenLiteSpeed, PHP-FPM tuning
* Deploying Laravel or Node.js/Next.js apps; PM2/Supervisor
* Load balancer setup (Nginx, HAProxy, cloud LB)
* AWS CloudFront and other AWS services (EC2, Route 53, CloudWatch)
* Bash scripting, Ansible, Docker, CI/CD

Ready for an exciting journey? Apply now and be part of our awesome team! We're excited to hear from you!

* Solid knowledge of API security standards — OAuth2, JWT, API key management, RBAC, ABAC, and Azure AD / SSO integration.
* Experience with asynchronous programming in Python (asyncio, Celery, message queues) for building non-blocking, high-throughput services.
* Proven track record of mentoring Python developers and driving technical direction across cross-functional engineering teams.
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD tooling, and Agile delivery using Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.

**What You'll Bring**

* API Craft — A deep appreciation for clean, well-documented, and developer-friendly API design that balances performance, security, and usability.
* Mentorship Passion — A genuine commitment to developing Python engineers through coaching, pair programming, constructive code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Pattern-Driven Thinking — A disciplined approach to applying the right software design patterns to ensure maintainable, scalable, and testable backend services.
* Communication Skills — Ability to translate complex backend and API concepts clearly for frontend engineers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ownership & Accountability — A strong sense of responsibility for team velocity, API reliability, and the overall quality of backend services in production.
* Collaborative Spirit — An inclusive mindset that fosters strong working relationships across frontend, DevOps, QA, and product disciplines.
* Continuous Improvement — A drive to stay current with the Python ecosystem, API tooling trends, and evolving backend engineering best practices.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. title: Engineer III - Cloud
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
  
  
****About The Role:****
We're hiring a Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain SOAR connectors that integrate third-party security platforms with Falcon Fusion, and build/maintain platform services that provide core orchestration and workflow capabilities to all users of CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon Platform.
  
  
Falcon Fusion – a core 'tier one' offering in our Flagship Platform, Falcon – is used by customers to automate breach remediations within their environments. It also serves as the runtime for apps built by our Foundry Module and is 'dogfooded' internally to automate workflows and accelerate development. Processing anywhere from 500M to 10B+ events per day, it is utilized by essentially every customer of the Falcon Platform.
  
  
This role is for an experienced backend microservices developer adept with cloud engineering principles. Your passion and meticulous attention to performance, reliability, and scalability will be key ingredients to your success at CrowdStrike.
  
  
****What You'll Do:****

* Build production-grade SOAR connectors that integrate security platforms (SIEM, EDR, ticketing, IAM) with Falcon Fusion at scale, and contribute to core platform services powering connector execution, authentication, and orchestration.
* You'll own connectors end-to-end—from API research through deployment and production support—while improving underlying platform capabilities (auth systems, testing frameworks, deployment pipelines).
* Research, evaluate, and integrate new security platforms and APIs to expand our connector portfolio.
* Develop both connectors and platform services working with complex authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, API keys).
* Build and maintain automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines to ensure connector quality and reliability across multi-region deployments.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with existing connectors and platform services, taking operational ownership across our fleet of Falcon environments.
* Write technical documentation including integration guides, API specifications, and troubleshooting runbooks.

****What You'll Need:****

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 6+ years of experience designing, implementing, and maintaining software systems across all phases of the development lifecycle, preferably in a SaaS model.
* Fluency in at least one programming language, preferably Python or Go.
* Proven expertise in building distributed systems, microservices, and REST APIs.
* Experience developing applications using SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Hands-on experience in large-scale system architecture, high scalability, availability, and optimization.
* Demonstrated track record of operational excellence when operating services that span many components across several geographical regions
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
* Strong communication skills with a track record of working collaboratively across stakeholders.

****Bonus Points:****

* Experience with commercial cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Contributions to open-source communities.
* Hands-on Golang experience.
* Prior experience with (cybersecurity) platforms or integrations.

****Benefits Of Working At CrowdStrike:****

* Market leader in compensation and equity awards
* Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
* Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
* Paid parental and adoption leaves
* Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
* Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
* Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
* Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

We believe media entertainment is meant to be enjoyed, so we continuously evolve to provide personalized, best-in-class options that exceed expectations. We champion excellence, embrace emerging technologies, and offer industry-leading video services that feel made for each viewer.

**About DIRECTV India GCC:**

DIRECTV India, an independent capability center is our exciting new chapter in Pune where exceptional technical and AI talent come together to solve meaningful challenges and build what’s next. It’s a high-impact, high-visibility environment built to deliver on business-critical priorities. Here, your work directly shapes entertainment technology that reaches millions, while you grow your career in one of the world’s most dynamic talent markets.

**Our Purpose:**

We’re here to reimagine what’s possible in entertainment, delivering experiences that meet the viewer’s needs, timing, and preferences. With nearly three decades at the forefront, we stay focused on our people, partners, and customers, creating innovative experiences that fit seamlessly into their lives, wherever and however they choose to watch. Driven by values we truly live, we channel curiosity, care, and commitment into innovation, aggregating, curating, and delivering entertainment with exceptional services that bring the future closer every day.

**Our Values and Culture:**

We built our culture with our people, not for them. Our values unite every teammate which forms a culture grounded in care, challenge, and delivery. They are more than just principles; they are how we operate.

Anchored in a 30-year legacy of innovation and community, we’re building a future better than yesterday – for our colleagues, our customers, and our company.

**Functional EVP:**

Engineer quality into every stage of delivery

Quality at DIRECTV starts long before a product reaches the customer. As part of DQE, you’ll work alongside engineering teams to strengthen how software is designed, tested and released. You’ll drive automation, testing and quality practices across products and platforms, helping teams identify issues earlier, improve reliability and deliver with greater confidence.

**Position Summary:**

To help drive this next chapter, we're seeking a talented and innovative Senior Engineer, Quality Engineering to join our Test Environment & Data Management organization. This role designs, supports, and optimizes enterprise test environments, service virtualization solutions, and test data management capabilities that enable efficient software delivery across DIRECTV. You will partner with engineering, quality, DevOps, and platform teams to improve environment availability, automation, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in environment management, service virtualization, cloud-native technologies, and automation engineering with a commitment to engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Environment Engineering:**

title: Sr. Martech Enterprise System Engineer
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
Avalara's Marketing Technology team is scaling its execution capabilities and expanding its AI capabilities to keep pace with a growing go-to-market engine. The systems that power campaign execution, lead lifecycle management, and marketing operations, Workfront, Marketo, and our leads pipeline, require strong, hands-on technical talent to build, maintain, and continuously improve them.
  
  
This IC4 MarTech Engineer role is for a strong technical leader who can transition marketing capabilities from a digital marketing paradigm to an agentic marketing approach by integrating, automating, and configuring new agentic models and solutions across our enterprise capabilities, building reliable integrations, automating marketing workflows, and ensuring lead data flows accurately from capture to CRM handoff.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Build and maintain integrations between Marketo, Salesforce CRM, Workfront, and adjacent MarTech systems, delivering reliable, well-documented solutions.
* Engineer and optimize the lead lifecycle from capture and enrichment through scoring, routing, and CRM handoff, reducing lead leakage and improving data accuracy across the pipeline.
* Develop and maintain automation for campaign operations, asset management workflows in Workfront, and lead management processes in Marketo, replacing manual effort with reliable, auditable automation.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions by working closely with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, and Sales Operations to understand needs and deliver working solutions on time.
* Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues across Workfront, Marketo, and the leads pipeline, performing root cause analysis and implementing fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Write clean, maintainable code and configurations following team standards for API design, data handling, error management, and security best practices.
* Contribute to technical documentation by keeping integration maps, data flow diagrams, and runbooks current so the team can operate and onboard efficiently.
* Support peers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and hands-on collaboration, raising the technical quality of the team's output.
* Monitor platform health and proactively flag performance issues, data anomalies, or integration failures before they impact marketing operations

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Qualifications**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in marketing technology, enterprise systems engineering, or a closely related technical discipline have recent hands-on work building AI/ML systems
* Solid hands-on experience with Marketo, including program setup, smart list logic, API integrations, lead lifecycle configuration, and data management.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront, including workflow configuration, template management, and automation for marketing or creative operations.
* Experience building and maintaining lead management pipelines, including capture, enrichment, deduplication, and scoring.
* Demonstrated production experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, vector search/embeddings, or recommendation systems — not prototypes, but systems that served real traffic
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and JavaScript/Node.js, with experience owning AWS Lambda data pipelines from design to deployment.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and modern ML tooling (e.g., MLflow, SageMaker, or equivalents)

**Bar Raiser Expectations**
This role is a Bar Raiser hire. The successful candidate will:
  
  

* Hold themselves and others to high standards of technical quality, data integrity, and operational accountability
* Demonstrate strong judgment when making platform and technical tradeoffs, especially those that affect campaign performance, lead data quality, or system reliability.
* Raise the performance of those around them through mentorship, rigorous code reviews, and clear documentation.
* Simplify complexity, translating ambiguous marketing requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions.
* Challenge assumptions respectfully and bring data into technical decisions.
* Leave every system, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

**AI Expectations**
Avalara is an AI-first company. This role is expected to be an
**AI Bar Raiser**
, not a casual user of AI tools, but someone who embeds AI into how MarTech work gets done and elevates the AI capability of the team.
  
  
**Specifically, This Role Is Expected To**

* Use AI to accelerate development and troubleshooting, including AI-assisted code generation, API debugging, and automated testing for MarTech integrations.
* Apply AI to lead intelligence, leveraging AI/ML-based lead scoring and intent signal processing to improve pipeline quality and Sales efficiency.
* Automate content and campaign operations using AI tools to reduce manual effort in asset creation, QA, and campaign setup within Marketo and Workfront.
* Identify and quantify AI-driven improvements, e.g., reduction in lead processing time, improvement in MQL-to-SQL conversion, or hours saved through intelligent workflow automation.
* Share AI best practices with the MarTech team and Marketing Operations, helping peers adopt AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Apply AI responsibly, with awareness of data privacy, governance, and ethical use standards relevant to marketing data and customer information.

Candidates who cannot demonstrate specific, measurable AI impact in prior roles do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

Unleash Your Potential

title: DevOps Engineer
description:

  .

title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Tieto Banktech
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for
**two Senior DevOps Engineer**
(
**Azure Infrastructure & Cloud Operations Engineer)**
to join our Platform Engineering team and help us build production-ready, resilient platform foundations with
**Terraform**
, automated deployment pipelines, and reliable cloud operations at enterprise scale.
  
  
At
**Tieto Banktech**
, we power some of the Nordics' most trusted banking systems with secure, reliable, and scalable cloud solutions. We are on an exciting transformation journey-modernizing core banking through automation, infrastructure-as-code, AI, and cutting-edge Azure technologies.
  
  
If you thrive in a talented, forward-leaning engineering team where people collaborate, challenge ideas constructively, and help each other grow, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.
  
  
Why You'll Love Working with Us
  
  

* High-Impact Work: Build and host mission-critical financial applications serving Nordic banking customers.
* Modern Engineering Standards: Full commitment to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), GitOps, and DevSecOps principles—no manual click-ops.
* True Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: We support a modern, hybrid work culture that respects your time and well-being.
* Culture of Continuous Learning: Technology moves fast, and so do we. We dedicate time and resources for unlearning, relearning, certifications, and mastering new technologies.
* Collaborative & Open Environment: Work closely with cross-functional architecture, security, and product development teams in a flat, supportive organization.
* Knowledge Sharing & Team Growth: Join a talented, forward-leaning Platform Engineering team where sharing knowledge, mentoring colleagues, and helping others grow are part of how we work.

What you will contribute to
  
  
Infrastructure as Code & Automation
  
  

* Collaborate with the team to design, build, and maintain enterprise Azure infrastructure using Terraform and modular engineering patterns.
* Automate end-to-end resource provisioning and lifecycle management via GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines.
* Contribute to reusable deployment modules and automated cloud governance templates that can be adopted and improved by the wider engineering organization.

**Azure Platform Engineering**

* Help evolve and scale enterprise Azure Landing Zones together with the team, adhering to high availability and security benchmarks.
* Partner with development teams to accelerate cloud adoption, offering paved-road developer platforms and self-service capabilities.
* Standardize hybrid networking, API management, and identity integration across multi-tenant banking environments.

**Operations & Reliability Engineering**

* Ensure maximum availability and performance for business-critical SaaS products running in Azure.
* Monitor platform health, establish pro-active alerts, and contribute to root-cause analysis for complex operational challenges.
* Bring a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) mindset to continuously elevate platform resiliency and performance together with the team.

Cloud security & compliance
  
  

* Implement robust zero-trust security controls and identity management using Microsoft Entra ID.
* Secure secrets, keys, and certificates via Azure Key Vault and automated vault rotators.
* Ensure platform compliance with strict Nordic financial regulation standards and security audits.

What brings you success in this role
  
  
**Must-Haves:**

* Deep Terraform Expertise: Proven hands-on experience writing modular, production-ready Infrastructure as Code.
* Solid Azure Engineering Background: Strong experience with AKS, APIM, Azure SQL, Entra ID, and cloud networking (VNets, Private Endpoints, Firewalls).
* Operational Resilience Mindset: Hands-on experience troubleshooting, monitoring, and maintaining high-availability enterprise applications.
* Automation-First Philosophy: Strong background in CI/CD automation (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps) and scriptable workflows.
* Collaborative Engineering Mindset: You enjoy working as part of a strong team, sharing knowledge openly, giving and receiving feedback, and helping colleagues grow.
* Strong Infrastructure Engineering Competence: Proven ability to design, implement, secure, and troubleshoot resilient infrastructure across networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services in enterprise environments.

**Nice-to-Haves:**

* Experience with enterprise Kubernetes administration (AKS) & container security.
* Familiarity with observability stacks like Open Telemetry, Grafana, or Application Insights.
* Background in DevSecOps practices within regulated environments (Financial Services, Fintech, or Healthcare).

**We offer**
We offer you professional growth, meaningful projects, open culture and an outstanding work-life balance! We offer you an opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast-developing and important sector. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working. Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.
  
  
We perform background checks on all final candidates.
  
  
Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
  
  
Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto
  
  
**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**

* Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

**OpenShift & DevOps Engineer**
**Experience:**
5–8 years
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced OpenShift Engineer to deploy, configure, operate, and support application stacks on Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes platforms. The role requires strong hands-on experience in containerized application deployment, CI/CD enablement, release automation, troubleshooting, and production support in enterprise environments.
