* Build and support CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or equivalent tools for automated build, deployment, promotion, and rollback.
* Coordinate release deployments, environment promotions, application validations, and post-deployment checks.
* Troubleshoot deployment failures, pod issues, image pull errors, networking issues, storage issues, pipeline failures, and application runtime errors.
* Work with developers and operations teams to onboard applications to OpenShift and improve deployment reliability.
* Automate repetitive deployment and operational activities using Shell, Bash, Python, or Ansible.
* Monitor application health, logs, resource utilization, and platform events to support incident resolution and service availability.
* Maintain deployment runbooks, SOPs, configuration documents, release notes, and operational handover documents.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in OpenShift, Kubernetes, DevOps, release engineering, or application deployment support.

* Good understanding of OpenShift resources including projects/namespaces, pods, deployments, services, routes, ConfigMaps, Secrets, PVCs, and RBAC.
* Experience with container images, image registries, build configurations, deployment configurations, and application rollout strategies.

* Working knowledge of Git, branching strategies, release tagging, artifact promotion, and deployment governance.
* Experience in Linux administration, shell scripting, networking basics, DNS, certificates, and application connectivity troubleshooting.
* Ability to analyze logs, events, pipeline output, pod status, resource limits, and application errors to resolve deployment issues.
* Strong communication, documentation, coordination, and problem-solving skills in a multi-team delivery environment.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure, or hybrid cloud infrastructure environments.
* Knowledge of Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD, OpenShift GitOps, or OpenShift Pipelines.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code or automation tools such as Ansible or Terraform.
* Exposure to monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, or OpenShift monitoring stack.
* Awareness of container security practices, image scanning, secrets management, RBAC, and security context constraints.
* Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, DevOps, or cloud certifications will be an added advantage.

**Working Expectations**

* Collaborate effectively with architecture, engineering, security, application, and operations teams.
* Maintain clear documentation for design, deployment steps, SOPs, runbooks, and automation scripts.
* Demonstrate ownership in resolving issues, improving reliability, and enhancing automation across cloud platforms.

* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents

description:

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
The Senior DevSecOps Engineer is a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer with focused responsibility for integrating security into cloud infrastructure, delivery pipelines, developer workflows, and production platform practices across F&P Solutions. The role combines broad AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, and troubleshooting capability with deep expertise in IAM governance, vulnerability and open-source scanning, static analysis, policy as code, software supply chain security, cloud and container security, and automated compliance evidence. The job holder enables product teams to deliver securely by translating enterprise requirements into practical, reusable controls rather than relying on manual reviews or end-stage security gates. The role works closely with Product, Development, Architecture, Security, BISO, Quality, SRE, cloud service owners, and compliance stakeholders, bringing strong communication, sound judgment, and end-to-end ownership.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Senior DevOps engineering foundation: Design, build, and improve reliable, scalable, and automated AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD capabilities while applying security as an integrated engineering requirement.
* DevSecOps capability ownership: Drive practical adoption of secure software delivery practices across product teams, translating enterprise security, architecture, and compliance requirements into reusable engineering controls and implementation patterns.
* Secure CI/CD and policy enforcement: Embed automated security checks, approvals, evidence, and policy enforcement into GitLab CI/CD and related delivery workflows while keeping controls understandable, maintainable, and proportionate to risk.
* Application and dependency security: Implement and improve static analysis, software composition and open-source dependency scanning, vulnerability detection, secrets detection, artifact controls, and actionable remediation workflows using approved tools.
* Software supply chain security: Strengthen provenance, artifact integrity, dependency governance, build security, access boundaries, and traceability across source, pipeline, registry, deployment, and runtime stages.
* IAM governance and automation: Engineer reusable IAM patterns, least-privilege controls, role and access lifecycle automation, secrets/configuration management, access reviews, and evidence collection across AWS and delivery platforms.
* Cloud, container, and infrastructure security: Implement secure AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, network, workload, container, and Infrastructure as Code patterns, including scanning, hardening, admission controls, policy as code, and remediation automation.
* Vulnerability remediation enablement: Partner with product teams and security stakeholders to triage findings, clarify ownership and risk, prioritize remediation, remove false-positive noise, track exceptions, and drive high-value actions to verified closure.
* Compliance and audit readiness: Automate control evidence where practical, improve traceability, support ISO 27001 and related assurance needs, and maintain clear documentation for security controls, exceptions, decisions, and remediation status.
* Security enablement and influence: Coach engineers, create practical standards and examples, facilitate threat-aware design and secure delivery discussions, and influence teams without becoming a manual approval bottleneck.
* Operational security partnership: Support investigation and long-term corrective actions for security-related production issues in partnership with SRE, Architecture, Security, and responsible product teams.
* Other duties: Perform other related duties as needed or assigned.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Five or more years of experience in DevOps, cloud, platform, infrastructure, security, or software engineering environments.
* Experience working in an enterprise or global organization with distributed teams.
* Experience collaborating with security, compliance, enterprise architecture, cloud platform, SRE, vendor, and product teams.
* Experience with Datadog, CloudWatch, SonarQube/SonarQ, JFrog, Veracode, LaunchDarkly, Helm, Ansible, secrets management, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with application stacks such as PostgreSQL, .NET, Angular, APIs, or cloud-native microservices.
* Relevant AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, DevOps, platform engineering, or security certifications.
* Experience mentoring engineers, raising technical standards, and enabling adoption through documentation, coaching, reusable examples, and hands-on collaboration.
* Experience supporting ISO 27001, audit readiness, secure software development lifecycle practices, or regulated environments.
* Experience with Veracode, SonarQube/SonarQ, JFrog, GitLab security capabilities, AWS security services, Open Policy Agent, Gatekeeper, or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with threat modeling, security architecture reviews, SBOM, artifact signing, provenance, or supply chain security frameworks.
* Relevant cloud security, DevSecOps, application security, Kubernetes security, or information security certifications.

**What’s In It for You**

* Normal office and hybrid working conditions in Pune, India.
* Up to 20% domestic and international travel, as required.
* Occasional work outside normal business hours may be required for priority security events, production support, or planned changes.

**Why Hilti**
Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.
  
  
**Commitment to Inclusion**
At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

Every foundational decision gets made once, by this person, and lived with for years. That takes someone senior enough to set direction and own it. Ideally as an early or first infra hire with full accountability.Kubernetes Expertise (Managed & On-Prem): Strong experience with cloud-managed K8s (EKS/GKE) as well as self-hosted, bare-metal, or lightweight distributions (e.g., K3s, Rancher, OpenShift) for on-premise setups. Deep grasp of namespace-per-tenant patterns, ResourceQuota/LimitRange, NetworkPolicy (default-deny), Pod Security Admission, and autoscaling.Hybrid Networking & Connectivity: Experience with secure cross-environment networking (VPNs, mTLS, reverse proxies, WireGuard) to establish reliable communication between cloud control planes and on-premise execution nodes.Terraform / IaC: Modular design (network / cluster / IAM / tenant-namespace / addons), remote state with locking, and state-splitting for blast-radius control. Works well directly within a small, fast-moving technical team.Nice-to-havesGitOps Patterns: Experience with multi-cluster management and GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux) for deploying and maintaining workloads across multi-region or on-prem environments.Multi-tenant Regulated SaaS: Experience with compliance (finserv, healthcare, public sector), data residency, audit logging, and encryption-at-rest requirements.Integration/ESB Runtimes: Familiarity with engines like Apache Camel or durable-execution/workflow orchestration engines (e.g., Temporal.io).API Gateways: Rate limiting, mTLS termination, per-tenant quotas.AI/LLM Infrastructure: Basic familiarity with vector databases, self-hosted inference, or GPU node pools.Tech stackOrchestration: Managed Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) + On-Prem/Lightweight K8s (K3s/Rancher)IaC & GitOps: Terraform, ArgoCD/FluxMessaging & Data: Apache Kafka (KRaft mode)Identity & Secrets: Keycloak (OIDC/RBAC), HashiCorp VaultObservability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki, TempoGreat People Rarely Fit Completely Into Job Descriptions.If you’re curious, driven, and excited by what we’re building, apply - even if your experience doesn’t match every bullet point.Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger teams, and better outcomes for our customers.Come build with us.

Technical Expertise – Strong hands-on troubleshooting experience across production or customer-facing technical environments — the single most important capability for this role. – Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containers. – Ability to read, interpret, and correlate logs, metrics, traces, and alerts. – Strong understanding of Linux, networking fundamentals, APIs, services, and distributed system behavior.

description:

Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
  
Position Title
  
  
Subject Matter Expert (SME) / Technical Lead – Windows Infrastructure, AD & AWS Cloud
  
  
Experience: 8–15 Years
  
  
Location :Pune
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced SME / Technical Lead with strong expertise in Windows Infrastructure, Active Directory, VMware Virtualization, Patch Management, and AWS Cloud Operations. The role will be responsible for managing enterprise infrastructure environments, driving operational excellence, ensuring platform availability, and leading infrastructure modernization initiatives across on-premises and cloud environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess deep technical expertise, strong troubleshooting skills, leadership capabilities, and experience managing complex enterprise infrastructure in a 24x7 operations environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Windows & Active Directory Administration
  
  

* Manage and support enterprise Windows Server environments (2008, 2012, 2016, 2019, and 2022).
* Administer Active Directory, Group Policies (GPO), DNS, DHCP, and Domain Controllers.
* Perform AD replication troubleshooting, health checks, security hardening, and disaster recovery activities.
* Manage user lifecycle, security groups, service accounts, and privileged access controls.
* Support enterprise authentication and identity management initiatives.

Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure
  
  

* Manage AWS cloud infrastructure and hybrid environments.
* Administer AWS services including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, Security Groups, EBS, CloudWatch, and Load Balancers.
* Drive cloud resource optimization and cost management initiatives.
* Support cloud migration, modernization, and infrastructure transformation projects.
* Ensure cloud security, compliance, and governance standards are maintained.

VMware Virtualization
  
  

* Administer VMware vSphere environments including ESXi and vCenter.
* Manage HA, DRS, vMotion, and Storage vMotion operations.
* Perform capacity planning, resource optimization, and infrastructure performance tuning.
* Support virtualization lifecycle management, upgrades, and patching activities.

Patch Management & Automation
  
  

* Manage enterprise patching solutions using SCCM, WSUS, PatchLink, and BladeLogic.
* Plan, test, approve, and deploy operating system and security patches.
* Monitor compliance levels and generate patch management reports.
* Develop automation solutions using PowerShell and related scripting tools.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation and process standardization.

Resilience, DR & Monitoring
  
  

* Manage Windows Failover Clustering and High Availability solutions.
* Participate in Disaster Recovery (DR) planning, testing, and execution.
* Perform capacity and performance management activities.
* Conduct root cause analysis for critical incidents and recurring issues.
* Implement proactive monitoring and service health management.

Service Management & Governance
  
  

* Manage incidents, problems, changes, and service requests through ServiceNow and Remedy.
* Ensure compliance with SLA, KPI, and operational governance requirements.
* Maintain technical documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles, and runbooks.
* Support audit and compliance initiatives.

Leadership Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to infrastructure engineers.
* Lead major incident management and technical escalations.
* Review infrastructure designs and implementation plans.
* Coordinate with customers, vendors, and cross-functional teams.
* Drive continuous service improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and technical trainings.

**Required Technical Skills**
Windows Infrastructure
  
  

* Windows Server 2008/2012/2016/2019/2022
* Active Directory Services
* Group Policy Management (GPO)
* DNS & DHCP
* Windows Failover Clustering
* PowerShell Scripting

Cloud Technologies
  
  

* AWS EC2
* VPC
* IAM
* S3
* EBS
* CloudWatch
* Load Balancers
* Cost Optimization & Governance
* Hybrid Cloud Operations

Virtualization
  
  

* VMware vSphere
* VMware ESXi
* VMware vCenter
* HA & DRS
* vMotion
* Virtual Infrastructure Management

Patching & Automation
  
  

* SCCM / MECM
* WSUS
* PatchLink
* BMC BladeLogic
* Patch Compliance & Reporting
* Infrastructure Automation

ITSM Tools
  
  

* ServiceNow
* Remedy
* Incident Management
* Change Management
* Problem Management
* Configuration Management

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent.
* 8+ years of experience in Windows Infrastructure and Cloud Operations.
* Experience in enterprise-scale environments supporting critical business services.

**Preferred Certifications**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
* AWS SysOps Administrator
* VMware VCP

description:
**About Sibros Technologies**
****Who We Are****
Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.
  
  
Learn more at www.sibros.tech.
  
  
****Our Mission****
Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.
  
  
Follow us on
  
  
LinkedIn | Youtube | Instagram
  
  
**About The Role**
****Job Title****
: Senior Manager (Software Solutions Architecture)
  
  
****Location****
: Remote, India
  
  
****Job Type****
: Full-Time
  
  
****Experience****
: 10+ years, including 4+ years managing engineers
  
  
You will travel to prospective and existing OEM customers and design how their systems connect to the Sibros Deep Connected Platform: vehicle-to-cloud connectivity, data pipelines, OTA update programs, and the integration points into their own manufacturing and after-sales systems. You are the person the customer's engineering leadership talks to when they need to know how this will actually work in their environment.
  
  
From design to delivery, your team sits at every step of the customer engagement and owns what comes out of it: the Sibros platform running inside the customer's own cloud account, with Sibros keeping ownership and day-to-day management of the environment, plus the customer-specific solutions that let the platform interface with an OEM's manufacturing and after-sales processes. You design the solutions that bring our product platform and our customers' requirements together. As part of the Infrastructure department, you help keep that platform performing reliably and at scale.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the customer architecture. Act as the primary technical contact for OEM accounts and prospects. Travel on site to run architecture workshops, technical deep dives, and the executive conversations that follow them.
* Design the integration. Architect how a customer's vehicle programs, cloud estate, and enterprise systems connect to the Deep Connected Platform, and make sure the design holds up against their security, compliance, and data residency requirements.
* Support pre-sales. Lead proof-of-concept engagements, architecture reviews, and RFP responses, and carry them through to a design that can be deployed rather than one that only reads well.
* Run the Customer Hosted team. Manage the engineers who deploy and operate the Sibros platform inside customer cloud accounts, where we keep ownership of the service without owning the account it runs in.
* Deliver custom solutions. Direct the design and delivery of customer-specific work built within the platform, using AI-assisted development tooling to keep delivery fast without giving up quality.
* Grow the team. Hire, coach, and set direction, and stay technical enough to be a genuine reference for your engineers rather than only their manager.
* Work across Sibros. Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Customer Success to turn a customer's business objectives into something we can build and operate.

**Basic Qualifications**
****What You Should Know****

* Experience. 10+ years across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, networking, and security.
* People management. 4+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance responsibility.
* Architecture. 5+ years designing, implementing, or consulting on complex cloud architectures, with production deployments behind you.
* Hands-on infrastructure. Strong Kubernetes and Terraform. You should be able to review your team's work on a customer-hosted deployment and recognise when the answer is wrong.
* Cloud. Working knowledge of at least one major hyperscaler (AWS or GCP), and of deploying into an environment you do not control, under someone else's security and compliance rules.
* Communication. Able to explain the same design to a customer's VP of Engineering and to the engineer who has to build it, and be understood by both.
* Travel. Willing to travel internationally to customer sites on a regular basis.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Connected vehicle, SDV, or automotive telematics background.
* Hands-on experience integrating cloud-native platforms with OEM enterprise backends (PLM, MES, SAP, after-sales).
* Experience running software in a customer-controlled environment, where you own the service but not the account.
* Familiarity with multi-region delivery across regions, and the requirements that differ between them.
* Comfortable using LLM-based tooling in daily engineering work. Experience with Claude Code is a bonus.
* Real-time and batch processing using technologies such as MQTT, Kafka, Kubernetes, time-series databases, and the analytics tooling on top of them, applied to connected vehicles or comparable IoT workloads.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation package with performance incentives.
* A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
* Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
* Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.
* Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance and wellness programs.
* A culture that values innovation and promotes a work-life balance.

****Equal Opportunity Employer****
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Senior Technical Engineer - Backup/Storage
description:
Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced Senior Technical Engineer - Backup/Storage to support our global Rubrik backup environment. You will operate, implement, and continuously improve Rubrik data protection across on-premises, datacenter, and cloud workloads, ensuring backups are reliable, secure, recoverable, and compliant with recovery objectives.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Operate and support the global Rubrik environment, including Rubrik CDM clusters and Rubrik Security Cloud, covering daily health monitoring, job success, capacity, and upgrades.
* Implement and expand Rubrik, including cluster and node deployment, workload onboarding, SLA domain design, replication, and archival.
* Protect a wide range of workloads, including VMware vSphere, physical Windows, Linux, and AIX hosts, databases (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server), NAS file shares, and cloud workloads.
* Manage SLA domains, retention, replication, and cloud archival policies aligned to business RPO and RTO requirements.
* Troubleshoot failed backups and restores, perform root cause analysis, and work with Rubrik support on escalated cases.
* Perform and coordinate restore testing, disaster recovery, and cyber recovery exercises, including immutable backups, anomaly detection, and ransomware recovery readiness.
* Plan and execute Rubrik software upgrades, hardware refreshes, and capacity expansion across global sites.
* Build backup reports and dashboards (e.g., Rubrik reports and Power BI) covering success rates, SLA compliance, capacity, and recovery readiness for the global landscape.
* Automate routine operations and reporting using Rubrik REST APIs and scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Python), and maintain infrastructure-as-code where applicable.
* Coordinate with storage, network, virtualization, database, security, and application teams, as well as datacenter partners and third-party vendors, to deliver and support backup services.
* Manage incidents, problems, and changes through ITSM processes (e.g., ServiceNow), and provide evidence for internal and external audits.
* Maintain runbooks, standards, and operational documentation, and mentor other engineers on Rubrik and backup best practices.
* Evaluate new tools and technologies to improve backup performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.

**Required**
**What you will need**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Rubrik operations and implementation, including Rubrik CDM and SLA-based policy management.
* Experience protecting and restoring VMware, physical servers (Windows and Linux), databases, and NAS workloads with Rubrik.
* Strong understanding of backup and recovery concepts, including RPO and RTO, retention, replication, immutability, air-gapped copies, and the 3-2-1 rule.
* Good understanding of storage (SAN, NAS, and object storage) and of the networking needed for backup, such as DNS, NTP, firewalls, and bandwidth planning.
* Strong Windows and Linux administration skills and scripting experience for automation.
* Experience with cloud archival or backup targets such as AWS S3, Azure Blob, or OCI Object Storage.
* Strong troubleshooting, written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work with global teams and vendors.

**Preferred**

* Rubrik certifications and experience with Rubrik Security Cloud (RSC).
* Experience with other backup platforms (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, Cohesity, NetBackup) and migrations to Rubrik.
* Experience with Rubrik REST API, SDKs, or Terraform and Ansible automation.
* Experience with Power BI for infrastructure and backup reporting.
* Familiarity with recovery and resilience frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 22301) and ITIL change management.
* Experience with ServiceNow CMDB and asset discovery tools.

title: Platform Engineering Lead- Data Services & Reporting
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly accomplished, hands-on
**SVP – Platform Engineering Lead**
to be based in Pune. In this critical engineering leadership role, you will provide engineering leadership, technical governance, and
**architectural alignment**
across our enterprise-wide
**Data and Reporting landscape**
.
  
  
This is a senior, highly technical engineering leadership and platform delivery role designed for a seasoned platform architect or software engineer. It is
**not**
a program management or PMO role. This position serves as a critical bridge that
**cuts across the entire data and reporting lifecycle**
—from raw data sources and federated query engines to the presentation, business intelligence, and AI-enabled experience layers.
  
  
You will hold
**complete design authority and technical governance**
over a platform that has a global footprint and affects business users and applications worldwide. You will be responsible for defining and driving our unified platform engineering strategy, standards, and best practices. Working in close partnership with our Enterprise Architecture teams and the wider department's AI design groups, you will lead the effort to rationalize our current platform landscape, ensuring that our data virtualization capabilities, APIs, and reporting engines are integrated into a cohesive, highly scalable, resilient, and sustainable end-to-end global ecosystem.
  
  
A core expectation of this role is the active adoption and promotion of generative AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and other developer productivity tools) to significantly accelerate software delivery, automate infrastructure-as-code, and elevate technical design quality across the entire data and reporting stack.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Cross-Cutting Platform Engineering Strategy & Alignment
* End-to-End Strategic Roadmap: Define and execute the long-term platform engineering strategy and technical roadmap that seamlessly integrates the enterprise Data Services and Reporting platforms, ensuring strict alignment with enterprise standards.
* Landscape Rationalization: Review, analyze, and hands-on rationalize the entire platform landscape—consolidating both backend data processing layers and frontend business intelligence/reporting inventories to eliminate redundant capabilities, reduce technical debt, and drive operational efficiency.
* Enterprise Architecture Partnership: Serve as the primary technical liaison with the broader Technology organization and Enterprise Architecture / Common Architecture Groups, partnering closely to translate enterprise-level blueprints into scalable, high-performance platform implementations.
* Unified Semantic & Metric Layer: Establish and enforce standards for a centralized, unified semantic layer that bridges federated query engines directly with BI platforms, ensuring consistent business metrics and a "single source of truth" from database to dashboard.
* AI-Accelerated Platform Delivery: Champion and drive the adoption of generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) across platform engineering teams to accelerate software development, automate schema and infrastructure-as-code generation, and streamline system refactoring.
* Platform AI Capabilities & Wider AI Alignment
* AI Capability Definition & Design: Actively work to define, architect, and design the core platform's AI and conversational query capabilities (including natural language interfaces and autonomous agent infrastructures).
* Departmental AI Coordination: Partner in close coordination with the wider department's AI architecture and design groups to ensure all conversational and agentic AI deliverables are seamlessly integrated, interoperable, and fully aligned with global AI patterns and security guardrails.
* Production Estate Management & Technical Debt Elimination
* Production Monitoring Standards: Enforce rigorous estate management standards by ensuring each application team designs and implements comprehensive, real-time production monitoring, observability, and alerting tools (e.g., Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, or equivalent).
* Tech Debt Prevention: Proactively drive platform patterns that simplify operations, ensure ease of production estate management, and systematically eliminate and prevent the incurrence of technical debt across the application lifecycle.
* Data Virtualization & Federation Industrialization
* Query Federation Industrialization: Lead the enterprise-scale industrialization of our query federation and data virtualization capabilities, establishing logical data access patterns that allow real-time query execution across dozens of heterogeneous catalogs without physical data movement.
* Standardized APIs & Data Access Patterns: Design and implement standardized, highly secure APIs and reusable data access patterns (leveraging Java/Spring Boot frameworks) to support high-performance, real-time data consumption by downstream reporting and analytical engines.
* Centralized Security & Entitlements: Enforce robust governance controls, row/column-level data masking, and fine-grained access controls (e.g., Apache Ranger) across the virtualization layer to ensure secure data delivery to all reporting consumers.
* Reporting Platform & Experience Layer Integration
* Reporting Platform Architecture: Modernize the reporting and business intelligence infrastructure, ensuring that high-concurrency BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, custom web-based dashboards, and automated document generation engines like Aspose) are optimized to query virtualized data structures in real time.
* High-Throughput Performance Tuning: Optimize query performance and end-to-end latency across the entire stack—from the query federation engine down to the frontend visualization layer—enabling instant, interactive dashboards and conversational data search.
* Technical Leadership & Mentorship
* Technical Mentorship: Provide strong technical leadership, architectural guidance, and mentorship to a global team of platform engineers, data architects, and reporting developers.
* Culture of Innovation: Foster a high-performance engineering culture focused on automation, continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD), and modern platform engineering practices.

Technology Skills & Competencies
  
  
**Required Technical Skillsets (Must Be Hands-on)**

* Java Software Engineering (Core Competence): Advanced, hands-on expertise in Java and enterprise Java frameworks (specifically Spring Boot, Spring Framework, and Hibernate/JPA). Proven track record of architecting, reviewing, and governing high-performance backend microservices, robust platform integration layers, and custom API layers.
* Data Federation & Query Optimization (Required Concepts): Deep understanding of distributed query execution, query plans, pushdown optimization, and logical data fabric/data virtualization concepts.
* BI & Reporting Platform Engineering: Strong architectural knowledge of enterprise BI and reporting platforms (e.g., Tableau, custom JavaScript/React web dashboards, Aspose, or similar reporting and document generation engines).
* AI-Assisted Development (Must-Have): Proven capability and hands-on experience using generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) to accelerate software delivery, write platform code, generate tests, and optimize development workflows.
* Enterprise Architecture & Implementation Design: Proven track record of designing and implementing high-scale, distributed, and resilient enterprise architectures bridging data storage, virtualization, APIs, and reporting in alignment with enterprise standards.
* API Design & Governance: Strong expertise in designing standardized REST/gRPC APIs, microservices, and secure data access patterns.
* Database Engineering & Security: Deep knowledge of relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server), distributed storage systems, and centralized data access governance frameworks (e.g., Apache Ranger).

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skillsets**

* Agentic AI & LLM Engineering (Highly Preferred): Conceptual or hands-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks and libraries (such as LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, or equivalent) to design, architect, and orchestrate autonomous AI agents, prompt engineering pipelines, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
* Data Virtualization Platforms (Highly Preferred): Deep hands-on or design experience with query federation engines such as Starburst, Trino, Presto, Denodo, Dremio, AWS Athena, or Apache Drill.
* AI Platform Engineering & LLM Architecture: Conceptual or hands-on understanding of engineering platform infrastructure to support AI workloads, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), managing prompt engineering pipelines, vector databases, and deploying model hosting platforms.
* Modern Lakehouse Platforms: Experience working with cloud-native enterprise data lakehouse or warehouse platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent).
* Distributed Compute Engines: Familiarity with Apache Spark (PySpark, Spark SQL) or Apache Flink for large-scale data processing.
* CI/CD & DevOps: Hands-on experience with modern DevOps toolchains (Jenkins, Tekton, GitLab CI), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift), enterprise workload automation (Autosys), and automated infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible).
* Production Observability Tools: Experience implementing and utilizing monitoring and observability toolsets (specifically Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, or similar) for enterprise-scale estate management.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Total Engineering Experience: Minimum 12-15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or data architecture within a large-scale, highly regulated environment (preferably financial services).
* Technical Leadership: Minimum 5+ years in a senior engineering leadership, principal architect, or platform tech lead role, with a proven track record of driving large-scale platform modernization, rationalization, and technical governance across both data and reporting systems.
* Agile Engineering: Experience driving technical delivery and architectural alignment within Scrum/Kanban frameworks, collaborating closely with engineering teams.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related engineering field.

title: Manager Product Software Engineering
description:
**Manager, Product Software Engineering**
**Job Description**
**Manager, Product Software Engineering**
is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering advanced AI-first systems while leading a team of engineers to build scalable, high-performance applications.
  
  
The
**role owns end-to-end delivery of intelligent platforms**
—including architecture, development, and production operations—while ensuring predictable delivery, quality, and team productivity.
  
  
This role
**operates in a 70-30 capacity (hands-on technical leadership and team management),**
**combining expertise in AI/GenAI tools**
with the ability to guide, mentor, and drive execution across a team.
  
  
In addition to hands-on system design, this
**role provides technical direction, people leadership, and delivery management,**
enabling teams to build secure, compliant, and high-impact AI-driven solutions.
  
  
The role may also
**guide cross‑team delivery by coordinating complex dependencies, driving architectural decisions,**
and ensuring predictable, high‑impact outcomes within an Agile, experimentation‑driven development environment
  
  
The role
**partners closely with product management, domain experts, and cross‑functional stakeholders**
to translate complex business and regulatory needs into
**scalable, secure, and compliant technical solutions**
, while reviewing and evolving system designs and technical documentation to ensure quality, maintainability, and alignment with organizational standards.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end technical and delivery execution of intelligent platforms, ensuring alignment with timelines, quality standards, and business outcomes including system architecture, development, deployment, and continuous improvement in production environments
* Lead the design and delivery of AI-first, cloud-native solutions, ensuring high quality, scalability, reliability, and strong customer impact across mission‑critical systems
* Drive the resolution of complex technical and AI-specific challenges, performing deep system analysis and implementing resilient, long-term solutions
* Partner closely with product management, domain experts, and stakeholders to translate complex business and regulatory needs into secure, compliant, and explainable AI solutions.
* Mentor, coach, and manage engineers through structured feedback, goal setting, and performance management, fostering a high-performing engineering team
* Apply strong business acumen to ensure technology decisions align with strategic goals, driving innovation while balancing quality, speed, and operational excellence.
* Ensure on-time delivery of features and releases, balancing speed, quality, and technical debt management
* Define and drive AI architecture standards, frameworks, and best practices covering GenAI, RAG pipelines, agentic workflow etc.

**Team Leadership & Delivery Management**

* Lead and manage a team of engineers, ensuring high performance, accountability, and continuous growth
* Own sprint delivery, capacity planning, and execution predictability across the team
* Conduct performance reviews, career development discussions, and mentoring
* Drive hiring, onboarding, and skill development initiatives

**Technical Skills:**

* Core Tech stack:

+ Expertise in .NET Technologies, C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core, OOP, and Python (optional/ good to have) for Web and GenAI solutions.
+ Design and implement RESTful APIs and microservices using ASP.NET Core.
+ MUST HAVE - Hands-on with MS SQL Server, VS Code, Visual Studio 2022, Azure DevOps, and Agile delivery.

* Front End Skills

+ MUST HAVE - Develop dynamic, responsive UI components using ReactJS (19).
+ MUST HAVE - Write clean, modular TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap,
+ GOOD TO HAVE - Ensure cross-browser compatibility, responsiveness, and optimized UI performance.

* AI SDLC:

+ MUST HAVE - Proficient with GitHub Copilot (IDE/CLI/PR review) for code generation, testing, and standards compliance.
+ MUST HAVE - Proficient in building Agentic Skills / Copilot agents for automated PR triage and secure coding enforcement, Token Optimization.
+ MUST HAVE - Proficient in implementing features using SDD (spec-kit, Open spec) or equivalent frameworks

* Design Architecture and Quality:

+ Strong experience with Agile/Scrum, TDD, and unit testing.
+ Application of design patterns and design principles to solve software design challenges.
+ Develop web applications with excellent usability and user experience.
+ GOOD TO HAVE - Experience with RabbitMQ or Kafka for event-driven architectures
+ Optimize backend performance and ensure high availability.

* Cloud and DevOps:

+ MUST HAVE - Deploy applications on Azure OR AWS
+ MUST HAVE - Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins
+ MUST HAVE - Work with Docker and AWS Elastic container (EC2) for containerization and orchestration, S3 Bucket
+ MUST HAVE - Azure PaaS experience: Azure AD, App Services, Azure SQL, Service Bus, Blob Storage.

* GenAI & Orchestration (Good to have):

+ Good understanding of modern GenAI and Agentic AI technologies, including AI orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering, and enterprise RAG architecture. Experience building reliable AI solutions through structured tool integration, validation mechanisms, and advanced retrieval techniques that improve accuracy, scalability, and governance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience in software development.
* Proven experience leading small to mid-sized engineering teams
* Experience in managing delivery in Agile/Scrum environments
* 5+ years’ experience in demonstrating ability to balance hands-on development with people management responsibilities
* 12 to 15 years of programming experience in Microsoft technologies
* 4+ years’ experience developing Single Page Applications using ReactJS (Must have)
* 8+ years’ experience building high-traffic, public-facing web applications
* 5+ years’ Experience using Azure PaaS/SaaS based technologies, designing H/A multi-region solutions
* 8+ years’ Proficiency with GitHub or equivalent tool for version control, code reviews, and integration with CI/CD pipelines
* Successful track record delivering high quality products on time while working in Agile Teams and following Agile methodologies
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively influence peers
* Experience designing and implementing stateful and stateless services in scalable, cloud-based systems
* Exposure to Cosmos or AWS DynamoDB (Good to have)
* Experience in Tax and Accounting field (Good to have)

Our Interview Practices
  
  
*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

title: Team Lead - Engineering
description:
**About Tripstack -**
Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining. Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform - giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non-partner, low-cost and full-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost-effective API. Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily. Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection. For more information, visit: www.tripstack.com ,www.etraveligroup.com
  
  
**Role Overview :**
As a Technical Lead on the Content team, you will architect software that ensures people can find the best flight combinations, as well as making Tripstack's software solid and scalable. A successful candidate will thrive in and help lead fast-paced environments that leverage agile planning techniques, encourage and reward creative design and intelligent risk taking, and find innovative ways to leverage cutting-edge technology. You will lead a high-performing team to ensure our systems are scalable and low-latency. You will drive the technical roadmap, mentor senior engineers, and balance innovative feature development with technical debt management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure high-quality delivery by owning the development from ideation, planning, design, implementation, and quality assurance to post-production monitoring.
* Ensure the team's technical decisions are consistently correct, and revisit them when the context changes.
* Unblock the team on technical ambiguity by resolving it quickly and directly.
* Strategize and support the team in unblocking itself using existing company resources and cross team collaboration.
* Author and approve code and designs that rarely require architectural rework after release.
* Ensure the team's solutions follow code guidelines and apply secure and defensive coding practices as a default.
* Build scalable, low-latency, fault-tolerant systems empirically proven through load and stress testing.
* Flag known tradeoffs before they become incidents.
* Track, plan, and resolve tech debt consciously so that it doesn’t pile up.
* Ensure the team's releases are monitored, documented, and supportable.
* Act as scrum master for the team.
* Improve the SDLC and project workflow for the team and group.
* Create an inclusive environment where every engineer can contribute and be heard.
* Promote team building and a durable team culture.
* Encourage responsible AI adoption within the team.
* Set clear expectations for how AI-assisted work is reviewed before it merges.
* You translate broader business objectives into clear engineering tasks while shielding the team from unnecessary external noise.
* Remove blockers using approved AI tooling.

**Requirements -**

* 8 to 12 years of experience in software development using C#, .Net core, javascript, and typescript.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading an agile development team.
* Strong experience in leading a mid-sized team (7-10) which includes developers and QA Engineers.
* Strong experience in developing and integrating REST APIs, XML, JSON, and SOAP.
* Strong architectural & system design skills.
* Experience in GCP/AWS is a plus.
* Strong experience with code review tools like SonarQube, etc.
* Hands-on experience in driving ambiguous problem areas in existing or new software initiatives.
* Proven experience in solving complex architecture and business problems with solutions that are extensible, simple, and optimal.
* Ability to think in terms of integrating systems and networks as well as programs.
* Strong Experience influencing software engineering best practices within your team, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations.
* Experience taking a leading role in building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers with other engineers working under your guidance.
* Experience mentoring software engineers to improve their skills, and making them more effective software engineers.
* Experience in communicating with engineering leadership to understand requirements describing software product features, technical designs, and product strategy.
* Experience in system development skills in C#.
* Experience upskilling senior engineers in AI-assisted coding.
* Proficiency in using AI tools like Claude to improve efficiency of SDLC.

**What Success Looks Like -**

* The team regularly meets the delivery commitments on quality.
* Technical ambiguity does not stall the team; decisions are made and communicated quickly.
* Post-release architectural rework, rollbacks or incidents are rare.
* Engineers on the team describe it as a place where they express themselves and produce their best work.

**Other:**

* Work Mode : Hybrid
* Work Timings: 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM.
* Second level of On call support for production systems that are owned by team

**What it takes to succeed here -**
Ambition and dedication to make a difference and change the way people travel; Where we always play to each other's strength in a high performing team reaching for our common goal. We hold ourselves to the highest expectations, and move with a sense of urgency and hold ourselves accountable and win by staying true to what we believe in.
  
  
**What we offer -**
We offer an opportunity to work with a young, dynamic, and a growing team composed of high-caliber professionals. We value professionalism and promote a culture where individuals are encouraged to do more and be more. If you feel you share our passion for excellence, and growth, then look no further. We have an ambitious mission, and we need a world-class team to make it a reality. Upgrade to a First Class team!
  
  
**Diversity disclaimer -**
At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

title: Engineering Operations Lead
description:
**Engineering Operations Lead**

**Location:**
Pune/Bengaluru, India (hybrid) |
**Team:**
Engineering |
**Reporting to:**
CTO

**OVERVIEW**

APEXX is an
**independent, enterprise payment orchestration platform.**
Merchants connect to APEXX once and reach the world's payment ecosystem:
**acquirers, alternative payment methods (APMs), Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers and network tokenisation.**
Our
**routing engine (AIRE), cascading, Smart Split and Revenue Protect decide in milliseconds where each transaction should go to maximise acceptance and minimise cost.**
We don't own an acquirer, so our only incentive is the merchant's outcome.

We're backed by
**MMC, Forward Partners, Alliance VC & Finch Capital**
and growing with enterprise travel and eCommerce merchants including
**Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, CarTrawler and Hotelbeds.**

We're looking for an
**Engineering Operations Lead**
to strengthen how our Product & Technology team operates, collaborates and delivers.

Working closely with our CTO and Engineering Leadership Team, you'll take ownership of our Atlassian ecosystem, improve delivery governance, release readiness and engineering performance visibility, and use AI, automation and modern development tools to build smarter, more scalable ways of working.

Your initial focus will be transforming Jira and Confluence, establishing effective workflows, reporting and platform governance, before expanding into broader technology operations, engineering productivity and strategic support for the CTO.

This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, delivery management and operational improvement, ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, building practical solutions and helping engineering teams perform at their best.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

**Atlassian Platform & Engineering Operations**

* **Own and transform our Atlassian ecosystem:**
  take responsibility for Jira, Confluence and Jira Service Management, improving configurations, workflows, permissions, integrations and overall platform governance.
* **Standardise engineering workflows:**
  establish consistent, scalable processes across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, reducing unnecessary complexity while supporting different teams' delivery needs.
* **Build automation and integrations:**
  connect Jira with GitLab, Slack, CI/CD tooling and other systems to improve traceability, data quality and operational efficiency.
* **Maintain secure, reliable platforms:**
  oversee access controls, configuration standards, documentation and audit trails in support of our PCI DSS, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environment.
* **Drive platform adoption and improvement:**
  troubleshoot issues, simplify legacy configurations and enable teams through documentation, training and self-service capabilities.

**Technology Delivery, Governance & CTO Office**

* **Strengthen delivery governance:**
  establish consistent approaches to planning, tracking, reporting and managing delivery commitments across Product and Technology teams.
* **Improve engineering performance visibility:**
  develop dashboards and reporting covering DORA metrics, cycle time, throughput, sprint predictability, delivery bottlenecks and defect trends.
* **Support release readiness:**
  coordinate visibility into outstanding defects, testing progress, dependencies, operational risks and release milestones, helping teams identify and address issues before deployment.
* **Drive cross-functional delivery:**
  track key initiatives, milestones, dependencies and risks across Engineering, Product, Platform and QA, proactively escalating blockers and supporting resolution.
* **Improve incident and problem management:**
  strengthen incident tracking, escalation, root-cause analysis and follow-through on corrective and preventative actions.
* **Partner with the CTO:**
  translate technology priorities into structured initiatives, coordinate team reviews, maintain visibility into key decisions and commitments, and prepare concise executive & board reporting with storytelling at heart.
* **Champion delivery effectiveness:**
  identify recurring operational challenges, challenge inefficient processes and work with engineering leaders to improve predictability, accountability and execution.

**AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* **Build intelligent automation:**
  develop workflows, integrations and lightweight internal tools using APIs, scripting, automation platforms and AI-assisted development.
* **Develop practical AI solutions:**
  explore and implement AI agents, intelligent reporting, ticket triage, knowledge retrieval and other solutions that improve engineering productivity and operational effectiveness.
* **Improve technology knowledge management:**
  strengthen documentation, knowledge sharing and AI-assisted search across Confluence and other internal platforms.
* **Connect and optimise our technology stack:**
  reduce manual administration, eliminate duplicated processes and improve the flow of information between engineering and operational systems.
* **Champion responsible innovation:**
  evaluate emerging AI and automation capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, appropriately governed and deliver measurable value.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Strong experience in
  **technology operations, technical delivery management, engineering operations or a similar role**
  within a software engineering environment.
* Demonstrable hands-on expertise administering and improving
  **Jira**
  , including workflows, schemes, permissions, automation, dashboards and integrations.
* Good understanding of
  **Agile/Scrum/Kanban, SDLC, engineering delivery processes, release management and delivery governance.**
* Experience coordinating technical initiatives, managing dependencies, identifying delivery risks and improving accountability across engineering teams.
* Familiarity with
  **engineering performance metrics**
  , including DORA, cycle time, throughput, defect trends and delivery predictability.
* Practical experience with
  **AI-assisted development, workflow automation, APIs or scripting**
  to build solutions and improve operational efficiency.
* Comfortable working with
  **Confluence, Jira Service Management, GitHub, Slack and modern engineering tooling.**
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience translating operational data into actionable reporting and recommendations.
* Confident partnering with
  **CTOs, Engineering leaders and senior stakeholders**
  , constructively challenging existing processes and driving cross-functional improvements.
* A proactive, hands-on approach, comfortable balancing platform administration, operational delivery and longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication and organisational skills, with experience working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience working within a
  **CTO Office, Engineering Operations or Technical Programme Management**
  function.
* Atlassian certifications or experience with
  **Jira Cloud, REST APIs, ScriptRunner, Forge or Rovo.**
* Experience with
  **Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, n8n or similar automation tools.**
* Experience developing
  **AI-powered internal tools, LLM integrations or agentic workflows.**
* Experience with
  **engineering analytics, release governance, incident management or IT service management.**
* Experience in a
  **FinTech, SaaS or scale-up environment**
  , ideally with exposure to PCI DSS, SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

**HOW WE HIRE**

**Three conversations:**

* a talent screen,
* a conversation with the hiring manager, and
* a practical technology operations, delivery and automation discussion.

The practical session will explore how you approach real-world challenges - improving Jira workflows, establishing delivery governance, interpreting engineering performance metrics and using AI or automation to solve operational problems.

You're welcome to use AI tools where appropriate. We're interested in how you think, validate and make decisions.

Once a decision is made, every candidate receives written feed-forward from the panel. Tell us about any adjustments you need and we'll make them.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* **Competitive compensation:**
  that recognises your skills, experience and impact.
* **Generous time off:**
  annual leave, public holidays and wellbeing-focused time away from work.
* **Work From Anywhere:**

  for you and your loved ones.
* **Personal accident insurance:**
  for when it's needed most.

  enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.

  opportunities to learn, grow and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

**WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE**

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams in the UK and India. For more than a decade we've helped enterprise businesses simplify payments through a single, scalable integration, with access to
**200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods and 10+ BNPL providers.**
We're trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon and Jet2.

APEXX is an equal opportunities employer committed to equality, diversity and inclusion.

title: Tech Resilience - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join Deloitte Cyber to help clients strengthen technology resilience and recovery capabilities across complex enterprise environments. As a Senior Consultant, you will support clients in identifying resilience risks, designing recovery strategies, and implementing solutions that improve preparedness for cyber incidents, operational disruptions, and technology failures. You will work across infrastructure, cloud, backup, and recovery domains to help organizations improve operational continuity and recovery readiness.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Conduct technology resilience risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities, technical risks, and single points of failure across enterprise environments
* Design and implement cyber resilience, disaster recovery, incident response, and business continuity solutions aligned to client requirements
* Design, build, and maintain isolated recovery environments and support recovery of critical workloads, including applications, databases, and directory services
* Assess infrastructure, application, network, storage, and cloud environments to improve resilience architecture, backup integrity, and recovery readiness
* Lead recovery testing, simulation exercises, runbook development, and client preparedness activities across resilience programs

**The team**
Cyber Defense & Resilience teams help clients defend against sophisticated threats by transforming security operations, leveraging technology, data analytics, and threat intelligence for continuous monitoring and rapid incident response. They manage dynamic attack surfaces and support business continuity through services such as operational resilience, crisis and incident response, and security operations center transformation.
  
  
Resilience as a Practice focuses on preparing organizations to anticipate, withstand, and recover from disruptions—including cyberattacks, natural disasters, and operational failures—by embedding resilience into processes, technology, and culture. Deloitte’s Resilience Team combines technical, operational, and strategic expertise to deliver integrated solutions for business continuity, disaster recovery, and risk management, ensuring organizations meet regulatory demands and maintain stakeholder trust during crises.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**.NET Application Reliability**

· Read, debug, and contribute to production C#/.NET code to diagnose and fix app-level reliability issues.

· Identify and resolve memory leaks, thread pool exhaustion, and GC pressure before they manifest as incidents.

· Partner with application engineers to embed reliability into new feature design and deployment practices.

· Instrument .NET services with distributed tracing and structured logging to surface runtime anomalies early.

**AWS Compute & Infrastructure**

· Operate and optimize EC2 Auto Scaling, ECS Fargate, and Lambda workloads — with clear judgment on when each is the right fit.

· Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code using CloudFormation or CDK for consistent, reproducible environments.

· Automate operational tasks, deployment pipelines, and disaster recovery procedures.

· Continuously reduce toil through tooling and automation, freeing the team for higher-impact engineering work.

**RDS SQL Server Operations**

· Manage RDS SQL Server deployments including Multi-AZ failover configuration and read replica setup.

· Operate backup and point-in-time recovery (PITR) processes and validate restore procedures regularly.

· Diagnose and resolve performance issues: slow queries, missing indexes, and blocking chains.

· Capacity plan and scale database infrastructure to support transaction volume growth.

**Observability & Monitoring**

· Build and maintain observability stacks using CloudWatch metrics, log insights, and alarms; AWS X-Ray for distributed tracing.

· Own service health dashboards, SLOs/SLIs, and drive data-driven reliability improvements.

· Design alerts that surface signal — not noise — and ensure on-call responders have the context to act quickly.

· Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) on incidents and lead blameless post-mortems to capture lessons and prevent recurrence.

**Networking & Security**

· Design and maintain secure AWS network topologies: VPCs, subnets, security groups, and NACLs.

· Configure and manage ALB/NLB routing, Route 53 DNS, and TLS certificate lifecycle via ACM.

· Author and review least-privilege IAM policies; audit roles and resource-based policies for over-permissioning.

· Support compliance and security controls relevant to a PCI-regulated payments environment.

**Incident Response & On-Call**

· Participate in on-call rotation to respond to production incidents and drive swift resolution.

· Define and track error budgets; use them to balance velocity and reliability investment.

· Communicate status updates clearly during incidents and coordinate cross-functional response.

· Maintain and improve runbooks, escalation paths, and on-call health over time.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

· Collaborate with platform engineering teams on architecture decisions and scalability requirements.

· Share observability and reliability best practices with application teams.

· Mentor engineers on SRE principles and operational excellence.

· 7+ years in SRE, DevOps, platform engineering, or a systems-focused software engineering role.

· C#/.NET engineering ability — can read, debug, and contribute to production code; experience diagnosing memory leaks, thread exhaustion, and GC pressure.

· AWS compute fluency: hands-on depth across EC2 Auto Scaling, ECS Fargate, and Lambda, with informed opinions on when to use each.

· RDS SQL Server operational experience: Multi-AZ failover, read replicas, backup/PITR, slow query analysis, and blocking chain resolution.

· Native AWS observability proficiency: CloudWatch (metrics, logs, alarms), X-Ray, and infrastructure-as-code via CloudFormation or CDK.

· AWS networking and security competence: VPCs, security groups, ALB/NLB, Route 53, TLS/ACM, and least-privilege IAM.

· SLO discipline: experience defining SLIs/SLOs against real metrics, running blameless postmortems, and carrying an on-call pager.

· Strong scripting ability (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for automation and operational tooling.

· Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, blameless engineering mindset.

· Genuine openness to adopting AI tools and a willingness to experiment with new technology to work smarter and faster.

title: DevOps Engineer (Jenkins Expert)
description:

Required Qualifications
  
  

* 6–9 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD engineering, build and release automation, or Jenkins administration.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Jenkins administration, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting in production environments.
* Experience creating and maintaining Jenkins pipelines using Jenkinsfiles and Groovy.

* Working knowledge of GitLab REST APIs and Git-based repository management.
* Exposure to Terraform and Infrastructure as Code for configuration automation.
* Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, network routing, reverse proxies, webhook payloads, and request/response handling.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience migrating CI/CD integrations or repository configurations from Gerrit to GitLab.
* Experience developing custom webhook relay or proxy services to route events to multiple Jenkins pipelines.
* Familiarity with Docker, Linux administration, Git, and CI/CD security best practices.
* Experience managing Jenkins at scale across multiple repositories, teams, or build agents.
* Experience automating repetitive administrative tasks through APIs and Infrastructure as Code.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
We are looking for a
**Jenkins-first engineer who can administer, optimize, integrate, and troubleshoot CI/CD systems hands-on**

title: NCX Senior Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is hiring an NCX Senior Engineer who is passionate about NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) infrastructure operations to join our DSX team. This role involves working closely with strategic NVIDIA Cloud Partners to build and improve the operational capabilities essential for running large-scale NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure reliably in production.
  
  
Your role involves guiding partners beyond the initial cluster deployment and validation phase into advanced Day 2 operations. These operations cover ongoing infrastructure health, observability, lifecycle management, quick remediation, performance validation, and operational readiness. You will engage directly with partner engineering and operations teams to develop consistent approaches that support NVIDIA workloads and the broader external customer environments of the partners. This is a highly technical, hands-on role at the intersection of NVIDIA accelerated computing, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and production operations.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead NCP Day 2 operational readiness efforts. Collaborate directly with NVIDIA Cloud Partners to set up the systems, procedures, automation, and operational methods necessary to consistently manage NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure following initial deployment and activation.
* Build continuous infrastructure validation. Develop and implement methods to continuously validate GPU, CPU, storage, and network health. Do this across large-scale AI clusters to identify degraded infrastructure before it impacts critical training or inference workloads.
* Establish observability and operational telemetry. Help NCPs implement comprehensive telemetry, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational signals across compute, GPU, InfiniBand/RoCE networking, storage, Kubernetes, and AI workloads.
* Develop automated detection and remediation. Build workflows to detect, isolate, drain, repair, validate, and return unhealthy infrastructure to service while minimizing disruption to customer workloads.
* Refine fleet lifecycle administration. Implement scalable strategies for managing sizable GPU fleets, including NVIDIA driver and firmware lifecycle administration, Kubernetes node maintenance, OS patching, configuration management, upgrades, and configuration drift identification.
* Operationalize NVIDIA reference architectures. Translate NVIDIA NCP requirements and reference architectures into production operating practices, validation criteria, runbooks, automation, and measurable operational standards.
* Define operational health and readiness. Develop health signals, SLOs, important metrics, acceptance criteria, and ongoing validation mechanisms that provide NVIDIA and NCPs with clear insight into infrastructure reliability and service readiness.
* Build reusable operational frameworks. Develop tooling, automation, implementation guides, runbooks, operational playbooks, and reference implementations that can be applied consistently across multiple NCP environments.

**What We Need To See**

* BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, cloud platform engineering, systems engineering, or similar roles supporting large-scale production environments.
* Strong experience operating Linux-based distributed systems and cloud infrastructure in production.
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes, containers, cluster scheduling, and the operational lifecycle of large multi-node environments.
* Strong understanding of production observability, including metrics, logging, alerting, dashboards, health checks, and operations guided by service level agreements.
* Experience crafting automation for infrastructure lifecycle management, failure detection, remediation, upgrades, and configuration management.
* Strong networking fundamentals and experience troubleshooting complex distributed systems across compute, network, and storage layers.
* Programming and automation experience using Python, Go, shell scripting, or similar languages.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience managing extensive GPU or accelerated computing infrastructure that supports AI training and inference workloads.
* Experience with NVIDIA technologies including DGX/HGX systems, CUDA, NVLink/NVSwitch, NVIDIA networking, InfiniBand, RoCE, GPU Operator, Network Operator, or related NVIDIA infrastructure software.
* Proven experience collaborating with NVIDIA Cloud Partners, hyperscale cloud providers, managed AI clouds, or extensive service-provider infrastructure and operating SLOs for large-scale compute infrastructure and using operational data to improve availability, performance, and fleet efficiency.
* Extensive knowledge of infrastructure observability tools including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Alertmanager, and scalable telemetry pipelines and translating reference architectures or infrastructure requirements into repeatable production operating models across multiple customer or partner environments.
* Knowledge of failure modes related to large distributed AI workloads and the infrastructure features necessary to consistently support extended training and production inference.

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world working for us.
