Owns reliability and execution for a significant Oracle platform domain, including incidents, lifecycle activities, routine maintenance, capacity risks, HA/DR readiness, and service-impacting improvements.
  
  
**Technical Depth**
Diagnoses complex RAC, Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, SQL performance, storage, interconnect, OS, backup, and recovery problems.
  
  
**Technical Leadership**
Acts as a primary escalation point, mentors engineers, reviews designs, raises standards, and influences application and infrastructure decisions.
  
  
**Execution**
Leads complex initiatives end to end, aligns stakeholders, manages dependencies, and drives permanent corrective actions to closure.
  
  
**Communication**
Explains technical tradeoffs, communicates clearly during incidents, and keeps risks, ownership, dependencies, and timelines visible.
  
  
**Automation and Standards**
Builds repeatable automation, CI/CD practices, runbooks, monitoring, and golden paths that reduce toil and failure risk.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Oracle RAC Platform Ownership
* Administer and improve Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, Clusterware, ASM, services, SCAN/listeners, and interconnect configurations.
* Plan and execute patching, upgrades, migrations, capacity changes, and lifecycle activities with controlled change and rollback practices.
* Design, operate, and validate Data Guard, RMAN, backup/recovery, failover, switchover, and disaster-recovery procedures.
* Performance and Incident Leadership
* Lead performance analysis using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans, SQL Trace, TKPROF, and OS/storage diagnostics.
* Diagnose Cache Fusion, GC waits, workload placement, connection storms, cluster instability, storage latency, and interconnect issues.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for critical incidents, lead stabilization and RCA, and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Engineering Influence and Shift-Left Reliability
* Partner with application teams on SQL, indexing, partitioning, schema design, bind usage, connection pooling, transaction boundaries, and resilient failover behavior.
* Establish database design reviews, deployment guardrails, developer guidance, and production-readiness standards.
* Automation and Observability
* Automate provisioning, validation, patching, maintenance, backup checks, DR exercises, health checks, and recurring remediation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
* Improve Oracle observability using OEM, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable tools; define actionable service indicators and objectives.
* Required Qualifications and Experience
* 8+ years of database or reliability engineering experience, including significant Lead or Senior responsibility for self-managed production Oracle RAC.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure/Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, RAC Services, SCAN/listeners, Cache Fusion, and interconnect behavior.
* Strong Oracle performance tuning and diagnostics experience using AWR, ASH, execution plans, SQL Trace, and Linux diagnostics.
* Experience with patching, upgrades, migrations, backup/recovery, DR exercises, and controlled production change.
* Strong Linux/Unix systems troubleshooting skills.
* Hands-on automation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or comparable tooling.
* Strong technical leadership, mentoring, incident communication, and cross-functional execution skills.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Oracle Exadata, OCI, Cloud@Customer, AWS, or hybrid Oracle deployment experience.
* Application Continuity, FAN, TAF, FSFO, Far Sync, GoldenGate, GDS, TDE, ZDLRA, or advanced Oracle HA capabilities.
* Database schema CI/CD using Liquibase, Flyway, Bytebase, or comparable tooling.
* Oracle certifications or relevant SRE/cloud architecture credentials.
* Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months
* Establish measurable reliability, MTTR, patching, backup/recovery, and DR-readiness baselines and deliver material improvement.
* Automate high-frequency and high-risk operational workflows, prioritizing safety, maintainability, and auditability.
* Establish a practical database architecture and production-readiness review process with measurable adoption by application teams.
* Deliver documented capacity, lifecycle, resiliency, and corrective-action plans for critical RAC environments.
* What This Role Does Not Include
* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is expected through technical direction, mentoring, and execution ownership.
* This is not a project-management-only role; the Lead DBRE must remain deeply hands-on.
* This is not a traditional DBA ticket queue; durable fixes, automation, standards, capacity planning, and reliability improvements are expected.
* This role does not own application code or business logic, although it influences database-impacting application design.
* The role does not assume unlimited or last-minute DBRE capacity; work must be planned, prioritized, communicated, and committed through the appropriate process.
* Work Expectations and Location

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

title: Senior MLOps Engineer - DSX Enablement
description:
NVIDIA is seeking a Senior MLOps Engineer to join our DSX Enablement team, collaborating closely with strategic customers to implement and enhance groundbreaking AI workloads. We partner with the world's most innovative AI companies and open-source communities to address their most challenging technical problems.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**
In this role, you will develop innovative solutions that advance AI infrastructure capabilities, advise infrastructure experts on the demands of ML workloads, help practitioners diagnose and solve full-stack AI and ML system problems, and work on a team with direct responsibility for the success of internal and external customers’ AI and ML initiatives, including LLM performance evaluation and supporting new hardware in open-source frameworks. You will:
  
  

* Build and deploy custom AI solutions on NeoCloud platforms and NVIDIA Cloud Partners (NCPs), including distributed training, inference optimization, and MLOps pipelines,
* Act as a primary technical contact for internal and external customers and partners, guiding joint engagements, ensuring the success of initiatives on DGX Cloud, and solving complex problems in production,
* Work closely with the teams building the infrastructure software and accelerated frameworks that support today’s most compelling AI applications,
* Profile and tune large-scale training and inference workloads on NCP platforms, leading efforts to reduce latency, cost, and operational risk, and
* Develop open-source tools and reference architectures to make it easier to build and manage machine learning and AI workloads, pipelines, and systems at scale.

**What We Need To See**

* BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in technical roles such as data science, data engineering, or ML engineering, ideally targeting large‑scale production systems.
* Demonstrated AI/ML experience across multiple phases of the machine learning lifecycle, from exploratory analysis to production systems.
* Facility with systems topics including Linux, batch schedulers, Kubernetes, distributed filesystems, and advanced networking at datacenter scale.
* Solid scripting and programming skills in languages like bash and Python and solid systems programming skills in a language like C++, Go, or Rust.
* Experience using machine learning or deep learning frameworks for training and inference.
* Excellent communication and technical presentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate architectures, trade‑offs, and recommendations to both engineering and leadership audiences.
* A clear record of engineering discipline and execution on interesting projects, whether you’re working alone or collaborating on a team.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience contributing to and working in open-source communities.
* Experience with the NVIDIA ecosystem, including DGX systems, CUDA, NeMo, RAPIDS, Triton, NIM, and NVIDIA networking technologies such as InfiniBand, NVLink, and RoCE.
* Experience and familiarity building machine learning systems in a security-critical environment and distributed training and inference frameworks.
* Familiarity with MLOps practices in a cloud‑native context: containerization, CI/CD pipelines, workflow automation, observability stacks, and GitOps workflows.
* Direct experience drawing on deep systems knowledge to diagnose and fix performance or correctness problems that span multiple layers of the application stack, like hardware, networking, accelerator, hypervisor or OS, compilers or runtimes, application code, and libraries.

NVIDIA offers competitive salaries and a generous benefits package. It is recognized as one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most innovative and dedicated people working here. Due to rapid growth, our outstanding teams are expanding quickly. Join us to make a lasting impact on the world!

title: Associate, SW Eng
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
As an Associate, Software Support, you will support business-critical Wealth Management applications and platforms across modern cloud, data, integration, security, and observability technologies. You are detail-oriented, service-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced production support environment where incident response, problem management, operational stability, and continuous improvement are key priorities.
  
  
You bring hands-on experience in application support, production operations, or site reliability support for enterprise-grade platforms.
  
  
You can troubleshoot issues across application, database, API, cloud, container, messaging, certificate, and infrastructure layers.
  
  
You understand Incident, Change, and Problem Management processes and can contribute to RCA, postmortem, and risk-reduction activities.
  
  
You are comfortable collaborating with development teams, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, cyber/security teams, and vendor/enterprise support groups.
  
  
**Skills**
BFSI, Wealth Management, or financial-services technology experience is preferred.
  
  
**Azure / AKS / Kubernetes / Azure Databricks / Apache Kafka / Oracle SQL / Neo4j / GraphQL / Apollo API Management / Dynatrace / PCF / CyberArk / Azure Key Vault / SSL Certificates / Unix / Java / ServiceNow / Python / Shell Scripting / Docker / Git**
**Roles & Responsibilities**
As a partner on the Wealth Management Application Support team, you will be an integral part of a cross-functional support and engineering ecosystem focused on production stability, client experience, operational resilience, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Provide day-to-day production support for Wealth Management applications, APIs, data platforms, and cloud-hosted services.
  
  
Monitor application health using observability tools such as Dynatrace and support alert triage, service restoration, and stakeholder communications.
  
  
Investigate issues across Azure, AKS/Kubernetes, PCF, Kafka, Databricks, Oracle SQL, Neo4j, GraphQL/API, Java, Unix, and related platform dependencies.
  
  
Support Incident, Change, and Problem Management processes in ServiceNow, including timely updates, evidence capture, escalation, impact assessment, and closure activities.
  
  
Contribute to RCA and postmortem documentation by identifying contributing factors, preventive actions, and service-improvement opportunities.
  
  
Coordinate SSL certificate management, secrets/access management activities, and secure operational tasks using CyberArk and Azure Key Vault.
  
  
Participate in release support, validation, disaster recovery planning, DR testing, and production readiness activities.
  
  
Partner with development, infrastructure, database, network, cyber/security, business support, and vendor teams to implement end-to-end solutions.
  
  
Create, maintain, and improve runbooks, knowledge articles, support documentation, dashboards, and operational checklists.
  
  
Use scripting and automation to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and strengthen operational controls.
  
  
Actively participate in knowledge transfer sessions and continuously build depth across supported platforms and business capabilities.
  
  
SUCCESS PROFILE
  
  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset with attention to detail and ownership through closure.
  
  
Ability to manage priority incidents with calm, structured communication and risk-based decision-making.
  
  
Collaborative working style with willingness to challenge the status quo and recommend practical improvements.
  
  
Commitment to operational excellence, documentation quality, audit readiness, and continuous learning.
  
  
Comfortable working in a global support model with alignment to business-critical service windows and change schedules.
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Sr Manager Client Technology
description:
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Manager, Cloud Platform Engineers to lead our India-based platform and automation engineering staff. This is a people-management role with real technical ownership -- you will be evaluated as much on your ability to review and stand behind your team's Kubernetes and Terraform work as on how you manage the people producing it. You will oversee day-to-day execution of AKS operations and Terraform-based automation, working in close coordination with the US-based Principal and Expert Platform Engineers who set the platform's architectural direction.
  
  
This role exists to provide direct, hands-on management and accurate technical oversight of the India-based team -- including work planning, prioritization, quality review, and status reporting to the Senior Manager, Cloud Platform. Reporting must reflect verified, actual system state; this is a core expectation of the role, not a formality.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Directly manage India-based Cloud Platform engineers, including workload assignment, prioritization, and day-to-day people management.
* Review and stand behind your team's Terraform module submissions and AKS configuration changes for correctness, adherence to documented standards, and production-readiness before they are considered complete.
* Enforce engineering process standards across the team: issue-based work tracking, triage and prioritization before work begins, work-in-progress limits, and daily status updates.
* Provide the Senior Manager, Cloud Platform with accurate, verified status reporting on the India-based team's work -- cross-checked against actual system and repository state, not summarized from memory or secondhand updates.
* Coordinate with the Principal and Expert Platform Engineers on platform architecture and standards, ensuring the India-based team's work aligns with the broader platform's GitOps, Terraform, and AKS conventions.
* Escalate technical or delivery risks early and directly, rather than allowing status to be discovered after the fact.
* Support hiring, onboarding, and skill development for the India-based team, including closing gaps in Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD fundamentals where needed.
* Apply policy-as-code and security standards already established on the platform (Kyverno or equivalent) when reviewing team output.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years in platform, infrastructure, or site reliability engineering roles, including some prior people-management or formal technical-lead experience.
* Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes, ideally AKS specifically -- sufficient to personally review a team member's cluster or workload change and identify problems.
* Working Terraform experience, including the ability to review a submitted module for correctness, reusability, and adherence to documented standards.
* GitOps experience (ArgoCD, Flux, or equivalent) -- all infrastructure and cluster changes should trace to a git commit as a matter of practice, not preference.
* Demonstrated ability to produce accurate, verifiable status reporting to senior leadership.
* Experience managing engineers directly, including performance management, prioritization, and workload planning.
* Working fluency in policy-as-code tooling (Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, or equivalent).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing a distributed or offshore engineering team reporting to a manager in a different region.
* Practical, current experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily engineering work.
* Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, or equivalent).
* Background modernizing legacy automation (PowerShell or similar) toward Terraform or platform-native replacements.

The company continually invests in innovative technologies, operational excellence, and talented professionals to advance healthcare delivery and create meaningful impact across the global healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
**Summary**
The Senior Platform Engineer for Leena AI is a senior individual contributor within the Platform Engineering organization, responsible for owning and operating Cencora's Leena AI deployment — an agentic AI platform used to automate HR, IT, and employee support workflows at enterprise scale. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role applies deep technical expertise to extend Leena AI's capabilities by connecting it to internal systems via custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, alongside platform configuration, integration engineering, and operational monitoring responsibilities.
  
  
Platform Administration
  
  

* Configure and maintain the Leena AI instance, including Knowledge Studio content sources, permissions and access controls, and governance policies.

MCP & Integration Engineering (Core Focus)
  
  

* Design, implement, and maintain Custom MCP Connectors to register internal MCP servers with Leena AI, enabling internal tools and data sources to be surfaced as agent actions.
* Configure and manage authentication methods for MCP servers, including: No Authentication (internal/public endpoints) Custom Header/API Key Authentication Admin OAuth 2.0 User OAuth 2.0

* Validate and troubleshoot tool discovery and runtime schema synchronization across connected MCP servers as services evolve.

Enterprise Integrations
  
  

* Maintain and enhance integrations with core enterprise platforms, including: Workday ServiceNow Microsoft 365 SharePoint

* Review execution logs, platform alerts, and credential-expiration notifications across all connected systems and proactively resolve issues.

Security & Governance
  
  

* Administer role-based access controls (RBAC), audit trails, and connector security across the platform.
* Manage OAuth credentials, API keys, secrets, and certificate rotation processes for all integrations, including custom MCP connections.
* Ensure platform operations comply with organizational information security policies, regulatory requirements, and data governance standards.

Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for HR, IT, and business stakeholders utilizing the Leena AI platform.
* Gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, including identifying internal tools and services suitable for MCP exposure.
* Lead requirement discovery workshops, solution-design discussions, platform demonstrations, and stakeholder presentations.
* Collaborate with Leena AI support and product teams on platform upgrades, feature releases, and MCP-related incidents.
* Mentor junior team members and promote engineering best practices, operational excellence, and continuous improvement within the Platform Engineering team.

**Experience**

* 6 years of IT experience, with expertise in systems administration, integration engineering, or conversational AI platforms such as Leena AI, Moveworks, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or Glean, including ownership of platform implementations and integration initiatives.

* Experience integrating SaaS applications using REST/SOAP APIs, Single Sign-On (SSO), and SAML.

title: Staff Engineer, IT Operations (SRE) [T500-30174]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.**

**About DIRECTV:**

Since our inception in 1994, DIRECTV has been part of millions of American households, delivering favorite shows, sports, and premium content anytime, anywhere. We believe media entertainment is meant to be enjoyed, so we continuously evolve to provide personalized, best-in-class options that exceed expectations. We champion excellence, embrace emerging technologies, and offer industry-leading video services that feel made for each viewer.

**About DIRECTV India GCC:**

DIRECTV India, an independent capability center is our exciting new chapter in Pune where exceptional technical and AI talent come together to solve meaningful challenges and build what’s next. It’s a high-impact, high-visibility environment built to deliver on business-critical priorities. Here, your work directly shapes entertainment technology that reaches millions, while you grow your career in one of the world’s most dynamic talent markets.

**Our Purpose:**

We’re here to reimagine what’s possible in entertainment, delivering experiences that meet the viewer’s needs, timing, and preferences. With nearly three decades at the forefront, we stay focused on our people, partners, and customers, creating innovative experiences that fit seamlessly into their lives, wherever and however they choose to watch. Driven by values we truly live, we channel curiosity, care, and commitment into innovation, aggregating, curating, and delivering entertainment with exceptional services that bring the future closer every day.

**Our Values and Culture:**

We built our culture with our people, not for them. Our values unite every teammate which forms a culture grounded in care, challenge, and delivery. They are more than just principles; they are how we operate.

Anchored in a 30-year legacy of innovation and community, we’re building a future better than yesterday – for our colleagues, our customers, and our company.

**Position Summary:**

To help drive this next chapter, we're seeking a Staff Software Engineer to serve as a senior technical contributor focused on observability engineering and production diagnostics. This role improves end-to-end visibility across distributed systems and enables faster root-cause analysis through telemetry, analytics, automation, and integrated operational workflows.

The ideal candidate combines deep distributed systems troubleshooting experience, broad observability technology knowledge, and a passion for turning operational data into actionable insights

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Technical Leadership:**

* Establish technical practices for production diagnostics, telemetry quality, and root-cause analysis.
* Partner with application and platform teams to improve service instrumentation.
* Mentor engineers in distributed systems troubleshooting and observability design.

**Technology & Delivery:**

* Build and support dashboards, alerts, queries, and operational analytics using Dynatrace, Splunk, Datadog, and related platforms.
* Monitor AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Java, Node.js, Oracle, Cassandra, and Kafka environments.
* Develop Python, Shell, and JavaScript automation for diagnostics and response.
* Integrate observability data with ITSM and incident management solutions.

**AI Ops & Innovation:**

* Use machine learning and event intelligence to improve detection and prioritization.
* Evaluate OpenTelemetry and open-source observability capabilities.
* Advance security, compliance, and operational governance practices.

**Qualifications:**

**Required Experience:**

* 6-8 years of progressive software engineering, site reliability engineering, observability, or IT operations experience.
* Experience implementing observability and AIOps capabilities across distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms, containers, scripting, service-level indicators, service-level objectives, and error budgets.
* Strong troubleshooting, collaboration, and communication skills.

**Required Technical Skills:**

* Dynatrace SaaS, DQL, and Grail

title: Azure DevOps and Terraform Engineer - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an Azure DevOps and Terraform Engineer to design, deliver and maintain enterprise-scale Infrastructure as Code capabilities across Vodafone Azure environments. You will create reusable Terraform modules, landing zones and automation solutions that enable secure, compliant and standardised cloud deployments.
  
  
Based in Pune within Data Centre Operations, this role requires strong experience in Terraform, Microsoft Azure, CI/CD, Git, cloud governance and Python automation. You will work with global stakeholders, Cyber Security and FinOps teams to support self-service adoption, improve deployment reliability and reduce manual provisioning.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Manage Terraform state, remote backends, state locking and configuration-drift detection
* Develop and maintain Python automation that enables self-service cloud offerings
* Build and operate Infrastructure as Code pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub
* Integrate security, policy and compliance checks into CI/CD pipelines
* Implement Policy as Code, role-based access control, tagging, encryption and network controls
* Apply Vodafone security baselines and relevant regulatory standards to cloud deployments
* Collaborate with Cyber Security and FinOps teams to deliver governed, cost-conscious solutions
* Promote the adoption of standard Terraform modules and landing zones
* Improve deployment success rates, pipeline reliability and compliance
* Help reduce manual provisioning through scalable automation

* The opportunity to deliver enterprise-scale cloud automation across Vodafone Azure environments
* Experience contributing to globally standardised cloud-platform capabilities
* Collaboration with Cyber Security, FinOps and distributed technology teams
* The opportunity to create reusable solutions that improve security, compliance and deployment reliability
* Involvement in expanding self-service cloud provisioning and reducing manual operational effort
* Exposure to Azure governance, Infrastructure as Code and automated compliance at enterprise scale

description:

Senior Cloud Devops Engineer

5–10 Years
  
  
**Approved Date**

**Role Summary**
We are looking for a
**Senior Cloud SecOps Engineer**
who thrives in a high-scale, multi-tenant environment. In this role, you will act as the bridge between
**Cloud Operations**
and
**Security Engineering**
. You will not just manage infrastructure; you will build the automated systems that allow us to securely onboard, monitor, and patch dozens of client environments simultaneously. Your goal is to deliver "Security-as-a-Service" efficiently, ensuring that a security issue in one tenant is detected and isolated instantly.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Multi-Tenant Operations: Manage and secure cloud infrastructure across diverse client environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), ensuring strict data isolation and network segregation.
* Automated Onboarding: Build "Zero-Touch" pipelines using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision security baselines (SIEM forwarders, Scanners, IAM roles) for new customers in minutes.
* Fleet Management: Design strategies to patch and update security agents across hundreds of servers/endpoints without causing downtime for clients.
* Centralized Observability: Maintain the central "Single Pane of Glass" platform that aggregates alerts and health metrics from all customer tenants into our SOC.
* Incident Response Support: Act as the Tier-3 escalation point for the SOC, investigating complex cloud infrastructure attacks or misconfigurations.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Cloud Agnostic: Deep hands-on experience with at least two major cloud providers (AWS / Azure / GCP) and their native security tools (GuardDuty, Sentinel, Security Hub).
* Infrastructure as Code: Expert in writing modular templates (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) that can be reused across different clients with variable inputs.
* Container Security: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes operations, including securing clusters, managing namespaces for isolation, and enforcing policies.
* DevSecOps Scripting: Proficiency in Python or Go to automate cross-account tasks (e.g., "Rotate access keys for these 50 client accounts").
* Compliance Ops: Understanding of how to implement technical controls for standards like SOC2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA in a cloud environment.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* MSP Experience: Prior experience working at a Managed Service Provider or handling multi-customer setups (e.g., using Azure Lighthouse).
* Policy-as-Code: Experience with tools like OPA (Open Policy Agent) or Checkov to prevent misconfigurations before deployment.
* Certifications: Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), AWS Security Specialty, or Azure Security Engineer.

Excellent written and oral communication skills required. Requires the ability to use a personal computer for extended periods of time.

title: DevSecOps Engineer - DevOps Engineer II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Dev Sec Ops Engineer, Consultant
  
  
Deloitte Consulting LLP
  
  
**About The Role**
Join a collaborative team building and running production-grade web applications that deliver real business impact. As a Consultant, you'll own platform design and operations across our Product Suite, with a focus on enablement, reliability, and maintenance. You'll apply modern AI tooling to accelerate delivery, shape infrastructure plans from the ground up, and scope and size effort estimates for prospective client engagements — all while mentoring junior engineers and partnering with global teams. This role is based out of Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Chennai, or Pune.
  
  
IDT anticipates how technology will shape the future and begin building future capabilities and practices today, driving the ideation, incubation, and scale of hybrid businesses and tech-enabled offerings. Partnering with the broader network and brings together dreamers, designers, and builders to deliver a unique point of view and future-proof both Deloitte's business and its clients.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cloud & Platform Architecture
  
  

* Design, plan, and architect end-to-end cloud infrastructure on AWS — VPC topology, IAM strategy, service networking, multi-account structure, and cost governance
* Own Kubernetes cluster operations across environments: provisioning, upgrades, RBAC hardening, network policies, autoscaling, and node lifecycle management

Delivery Pipelines & Automation
  
  

* Build and maintain GitOps delivery pipelines with ArgoCD — ensuring every deployment is auditable, rollback-ready, and environment-aware
* Author reusable, modular infrastructure as code with Terraform and Terragrunt, including safe remote state management and workspace patterns
* Design and maintain CI/CD workflows in GitHub Actions — multi-stage pipelines, build matrix strategies, environment promotion gates, and secret injection via Doppler
* Manage artifact lifecycles through JFrog Artifactory and enforce container image policies from build through registry to production
* Integrate SonarQube into the delivery pipeline to surface vulnerabilities and enforce quality gates before code ships
* Integrate with security vulnerability detection tools to enable quality validations

Observability & Security
  
  

* Stand up and own DataDog observability end-to-end: dashboards, APM traces, log pipelines, synthetic checks, and SLO tracking tied to real service agreements
* Establish security-first infrastructure practices — threat modelling, least-privilege access, compliance controls, and structured incident response runbooks

Platform Enablement & Team Leadership
  
  

* Partner with engineering teams to define platform standards, golden-path tooling, and self-service infrastructure patterns that reduce toil
* Actively use and promote advanced AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT plugins) to improve development productivity
* Mentor team members and contribute to a collaborative, innovation-driven engineering culture

Reporting Relationships
  
  
Reports to a Senior Consultant or Manager within IDT's platform engineering / DevOps practice. Partners with global engineering teams on platform standards and self-service tooling, and mentors junior engineers.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 3 + years in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering with meaningful production ownership
* Deep, hands-on AWS expertise — EKS, IAM, VPC, RDS, S3, CloudFront, and the services that surround them
* Strong Kubernetes command: has built clusters, debugged scheduling failures, and hardened them for real workloads
* Production experience with a GitOps toolchain; ArgoCD experience strongly preferred
* Terraform at scale — modules, remote state, workspace strategy, and team-safe workflows; Terragrunt a clear advantage
* GitHub Actions pipeline authoring — knows how to keep pipelines fast, secure, and easy for others to maintain
* Docker fluency from base-image selection through multi-stage build optimization and vulnerability scanning
* Hands-on DataDog experience building observability from the ground up, not just reading pre-built dashboards
* Security-first mindset evidenced in day-to-day approach to secrets, credentials, access control, and dependency hygiene
* Clear, precise written communication — architecture decisions, runbooks, and post-mortems worth sharing with the team
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and team collaboration skills
* Bachelor's degree (minimum three-year program) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

**Preferred**

* AWS is the required cloud platform; Azure or GCP experience is a plus

Core Competencies
  
  

* Security-first mindset across secrets, access, and dependency management
* Deep platform and infrastructure ownership from design through operations
* Clear, precise technical communication and documentation
* Strong problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
* Mentoring and contribution to a collaborative engineering culture
* Fluency with modern AI-assisted development tooling

Why This Role Matters
  
  
Reliable, secure, well-observed infrastructure is what lets every other team ship with confidence. This role owns that platform foundation end-to-end — from AWS and Kubernetes architecture through delivery pipelines, observability, and security — while mentoring the next generation of engineers and helping IDT build the hybrid businesses and enterprise platforms that future-proof Deloitte and its clients.
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
  
  
****About The Role:****
CrowdStrike's engineering organization depends on shared infrastructure platforms that power critical product capabilities. These platforms need dedicated engineering ownership to operate reliably, scale safely, harden for security, and mature into self-service capabilities that teams can depend on.
  
  
You'll own production infrastructure that spans multiple cloud providers and regions, serving engineering teams across the organization. The work is equal parts platform engineering and operational excellence — building automation, hardening security, establishing governance, and enabling consuming teams to adopt these platforms effectively. You'll also help shape what comes next as the team's scope grows.
  
  
We're hiring at all seniority levels — scope and compensation adjust accordingly.

Pune
  
  
****What You'll Do:****

* Run production infrastructure - Deploy, upgrade, and maintain platform services across multiple clouds and regions on Kubernetes.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines - Make it safe and fast to ship infrastructure changes using GitOps workflows and release automation.
* Build control planes - Create the APIs and tooling that make provisioning and scaling repeatable and self-service.
* Own capacity planning - Track usage, forecast growth, right-size clusters, and keep infrastructure costs in check.
* Build observability - Set up metrics, dashboards, and alerts using Prometheus and Grafana. Write runbooks that make on-call clear and actionable.
* Own on-call and incidents - Join the on-call rotation, resolve issues, write postmortems, and turn repeat problems into automation.
* Automate everything - Deployments, upgrades, certificate rotations, failover. If you do it by hand more than once, automate it.
* Driving system reliability by blending software engineering principles with AI-driven automation, moving from reactive firefighting to proactive, automated operations.
* Harden security - set up auth, encryption, secret rotation, and network policies. Keep dependencies patched and CVEs resolved.
* Own disaster recovery - Build backup strategies, test failover, and make sure platforms can survive infrastructure failures.
* Enable other teams - Provide templates, patterns, and direct support to help engineering teams use platforms reliably.
* Collaborate across teams - Collaborate with Infrastructure, SRE, and Data Services on shared operational problems.

* GitOps experience - ArgoCD or Flux for managing infrastructure deployments.
* Observability skills - Prometheus, Grafana, and distributed tracing tools like Jaeger or OpenTelemetry.
* Database operations - Backup, restore, schema management, and performance tuning for relational and NoSQL databases.
* Security mindset - You implement auth, encryption, secret management, and network policies as part of normal work.
* Multi-cloud or multi-region experience - you have managed infrastructure across providers or regions.
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

title: DevOps Architect (AWS & Python)
description:
**Job Title: AWS DevOps Architect**

**Job Type: Full-Time**

**Interview Type: Only Video**

**Duration: Long Term**

**Work Preference: Onsite**

**Work Location: Pune/Gondia, MH**

**Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced
**AWS DevOps Architect**
to design and implement scalable, secure, highly automated DevOps solutions on AWS. This role will define cloud infrastructure architecture, CI/CD standards, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container platforms, security controls, observability, and operational best practices.

The ideal candidate combines strong
**AWS architecture expertise with hands-on DevOps engineering experience**
and can provide technical leadership across application, integration, data, and cloud modernization initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define enterprise
  **AWS DevOps architecture, standards, reusable patterns, and reference architectures**
  .
* Design and implement highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient AWS environments.
* Architect
  **CI/CD pipelines**
  for applications, APIs, integrations, data workloads, and infrastructure.
* Establish Infrastructure as Code using
  **Terraform, AWS CDK/CDKTF, and CloudFormation**
  .
* Design containerized platforms using
  **Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and Amazon ECR**
  .
* Define deployment strategies including
  **Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling, and automated rollback**
  .
* Automate provisioning and configuration of AWS infrastructure across development, test, staging, and production environments.
* Implement
  **DevSecOps**
  practices including SAST/DAST, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, IAM controls, and policy enforcement.
* Design AWS networking patterns involving
  **VPCs, subnets, security groups, Route 53, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink/VPC endpoints, load balancers, and hybrid connectivity**
  .
* Establish centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational dashboards.
* Implement observability using
  **Amazon CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS X-Ray, OpenSearch, Prometheus, and Grafana**
  .
* Design IAM and security models following
  **least-privilege and Zero Trust principles**
  .
* Implement secrets and encryption management using
  **AWS Secrets Manager, Systems Manager Parameter Store, and AWS KMS**
  .
* Design solutions for
  **high availability, disaster recovery, backup, auto-scaling, and business continuity**
  .
* Build reusable Terraform/CDK modules, pipeline templates, and automation accelerators.
* Support migration and modernization of legacy applications and integration workloads onto AWS.
* Establish governance across multiple AWS accounts using
  **AWS Organizations, Control Tower, IAM, SCPs, tagging standards, and centralized logging**
  .
* Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Development, Integration, Data Engineering, and Operations teams.
* Mentor DevOps engineers and provide architectural guidance and technical leadership.

**Required Experience**

* **10+ years of overall IT experience**
  with
  **5+ years of AWS/DevOps experience**
  .
* 3+ years in a
  **DevOps Architect, Cloud Architect, Platform Architect, or Lead DevOps Engineer**
  role.
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS services including:
* EC2, S3, IAM, VPC
* Lambda
* ECS/EKS
* ECR
* API Gateway
* Route 53
* ALB/NLB
* CloudWatch and CloudTrail
* Secrets Manager and KMS
* EventBridge, SNS and SQS
* Step Functions
* Strong expertise in
  **Terraform**
  and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with
  **AWS CDK/CDKTF and CloudFormation**
  .
* Strong experience with
  **Docker and Kubernetes/EKS**
  .
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines using
  **GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild**
  .
* Strong scripting skills using
  **Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell**
  .
* Strong understanding of AWS networking, security, IAM, encryption, certificates, and private connectivity.
* Experience implementing enterprise
  **DevSecOps and security automation**
  .
* Experience designing monitoring and observability solutions.
* Strong understanding of Git workflows, artifact management, release management, and environment promotion.

**Integration Modernization Experience – Preferred**

Experience supporting AWS-based enterprise integration platforms involving:

* **Amazon API Gateway**
  for API management and exposure.
* **AWS Lambda**
  for serverless processing and integration.
* **Amazon EventBridge, SNS and SQS**
  for event-driven integration.
* **AWS Step Functions**
  for workflow orchestration.
* **AWS Transfer Family**
  for SFTP/AS2-based file and B2B integration.
* **AWS B2B Data Interchange**
  for EDI transformation and processing.
* **Amazon S3**
  for enterprise file and message storage.
* **AWS Batch**
  for large-scale batch processing.
* **Amazon MWAA / Apache Airflow**
  for workflow orchestration.
* Private endpoints and secure connectivity between AWS and enterprise/on-premise systems.

**DevSecOps Responsibilities**

The architect should establish automated controls for:

* SAST/DAST and dependency scanning
* Container image scanning
* Infrastructure vulnerability scanning
* Terraform/IaC security validation
* Secrets detection
* IAM and policy validation
* Automated compliance checks
* Artifact and container security
* Audit logging and traceability

**Role Expectations**

The AWS DevOps Architect will own the
**end-to-end DevOps and cloud automation architecture**
, ensuring that AWS workloads can be provisioned, built, tested, secured, deployed, monitored, scaled, recovered, and operated through standardized and highly automated processes.

This is an
**architecture plus hands-on technical leadership role**
, not simply a CI/CD administration position.

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)**
at Equifax is a discipline that combines software and systems engineering for building and running large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that internal and external services meet or exceed reliability and performance expectations while adhering to Equifax engineering principles.
  
  
SRE is also an engineering approach to building and running production systems – we engineer solutions to operational problems. Our SREs are responsible for overall system operation and we use a breadth of tools and approaches to solve a broad set of problems. Practices such as limiting time spent on operational work, blameless postmortems, proactive identification, and prevention of potential outages.
  
  
Our SRE culture of diversity, intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Equifax brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big, and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to build an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn, grow and take pride in our work
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Manage system(s) uptime across cloud-native (AWS, GCP) and hybrid architectures.
* Build infrastructure as code (IAC) patterns that meet security and engineering standards using one or more technologies (Terraform, scripting with cloud CLI, and programming with cloud SDK).
* Build CI/CD pipelines for build, test and deployment of application and cloud architecture patterns, using platform (Jenkins) and cloud-native toolchains.
* Build automated tooling to deploy service requests to push a change into production. Build runbooks that are comprehensive and detailed to manage detect, remediate and restore services.
* Solve problems and triage complex distributed architecture service maps. On call for high severity application incidents and improving run books to improve MTTR
* Lead availability blameless postmortem and own the call to action to remediate recurrences.

**What Experience You Need**

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding (e.g., physics or mathematics), or equivalent job experience required
* 5-7 years of experience in software engineering, systems administration, database administration, and networking.
* 2+ years of experience developing and/or administering software in public cloud
* Experience in monitoring infrastructure and application uptime and availability to ensure functional and performance objectives.
* Experience in languages such as Python, Bash, Java, Go JavaScript and/or node.js
* Demonstrable cross-functional knowledge with systems, storage, networking, security and databases
* System administration skills, including automation and orchestration of Linux/Windows using Terraform, Chef, Ansible and/or containers (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
* Proficiency with continuous integration and continuous delivery tooling and practices
* Cloud Certification Strongly Preferred

**What Could Set You Apart**
An ability to demonstrate successful performance of our Success Profile skills, including:
  
  

* DevSecOps - Uses DevSecOps operational practices and applies engineering skills to improve resilience of products/services. Designs, codes, verifies, tests, documents, modifies complex programs/scripts and integrated software services. Contributes to the selection of the software development methods, tools, and techniques. Applies agreed SRE standards and tools to achieve a well-engineered result. Participates in reviews of own work and leads reviews of colleagues' work.
* Operational Excellence - Develops work plans for short-term assignments of moderate complexity, typically contained within their own function. Consistently monitor and measure systems against key metrics to ensure availability of systems. Continuously seeks new ways of working to make processes run smoother and faster.
* Systems Thinking - Uses knowledge of best practices and how systems integrate with others to improve one’s own work and the work of less experienced colleagues. Builds and maintains an understanding of technology trends and uses knowledge to identify factors that achieve the defined expectations of systems availability.
* Technical Communication/Presentation - Articulates complex messages and the impacts to stakeholders to build support and agreement. Demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to tailor to specific audiences. Work with others to achieve results and proactively address sources of conflict and emotion with focus on the best solution for Equifax.
* Troubleshooting - Applies a methodical approach to routine and moderately complex issue definition and resolution. Initiates and monitors actions to investigate and resolve problems in systems, processes and services. Determines problem fixes/remedies. Coordinates the implementation of agreed remedies. Analyzes patterns and trends.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Job Title: Sr. DevOps Engineer (FNZ)
  
  
**About FNZ:**
FNZ is a global fintech firm transforming the way financial institutions serve their clients. By combining cutting-edge technology, infrastructure, and investment operations, FNZ enables wealth management firms to deliver personalized investment solutions at scale. Operating across multiple regions and supporting over $1.5 trillion in assets under administration, FNZ partners with leading banks, insurers, and asset managers to create seamless and innovative wealth platforms that empower millions of investors worldwide.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Sr. DevOps Engineer to join our Cloud Platform team. The ideal candidate will design, implement, and maintain enterprise-scale infrastructure deployment frameworks using Terraform,
  
  
Kubernetes, and Azure DevOps. This role is central to enabling repeatable, secure, and config-driven deployments of FNZ's wealth management platform across multiple clients and environments. You will contribute directly to our Application Deployment Framework, which orchestrates infrastructure and application deployments for private AKS clusters, container registries, databases, and networking across Azure..
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
Infrastructure as Code: Design, develop, and maintain Terraform compositions and reusable modules for Azure resources including AKS, ACR, SQL Managed Instance, Key Vault, VNets, and Application Gateway. Ensure modularity, testability, and adherence to semantic versioning.
  
  
Kubernetes & Container Management: Deploy and manage private AKS clusters with proper RBAC, cert-manager, ingress controllers, and namespace isolation. Implement Kubernetes resources using Terraform (not kubectl) following GitOps principles.
  
  
Helm Chart Development & Integration: Develop, customize, and manage Helm charts for application deployments. Integrate external Helm charts via the Terraform Helm provider, manage chart versioning, and ensure consistent deployments across environments.
  
  
CI/CD Pipeline Development: Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines using YAML templates with a script-first approach. Develop reusable pipeline templates (stages, jobs, steps) that integrate with config-driven deployments.
  
  
Configuration Management: Develop and enhance config-driven deployment systems where YAML configurations generate Terraform tfvars and pipeline definitions. Implement schema validation and maintain config generators.
  
  
Scripting & Automation: Write production-quality PowerShell modules following structured patterns (manifests, root modules, function directories). Implement proper error handling, logging, and testable code.
  
  
AI-Assisted Development: Leverage AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, improve code quality, and enhance productivity. Contribute to prompt engineering and agent configuration to optimize team workflows.
  
  
Multi-Environment Architecture: Support deployment across multiple client projects and environments (dev, uat, staging, production) with proper isolation, networking, and security boundaries.
  
  
Container Registry Operations: Manage multi-tier container registry architecture (Artifactory → Central ACR → Environment ACR) with secure image promotion pipelines and digest-based deployments.
  
  
Security & Compliance: Implement secure infrastructure patterns including private endpoints, network segmentation, managed identities, Key Vault integration, and TLS certificate management via internal CAs.
  
  
Testing & Quality: Write comprehensive tests using Pester for PowerShell and ensure all infrastructure changes include appropriate test coverage. Maintain existing tests when modifying code.
  
  
Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear documentation for infrastructure patterns, deployment procedures, and operational playbooks. Contribute to and follow established coding standards.
  
  
**Qualifications:**
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  
  
Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience with infrastructure automation and DevOps practices in production environments.
  
  
Terraform Expertise: Strong proficiency in Terraform including module development, state management, workspace patterns, and provider configurations. Experience with Terraform for Kubernetes resource management.
  
  
Azure Cloud: Demonstrated experience with Azure services including AKS, ACR, SQL Managed Instance, Key Vault, Virtual Networks, Application Gateway, and Managed Identities.
  
  
Kubernetes: Solid understanding of Kubernetes concepts including deployments, services, ingress, RBAC, Helm charts, and cert-manager. Experience with private cluster configurations.
  
  
CI/CD Pipelines: Strong experience with Azure DevOps Pipelines (YAML-based), including template hierarchies, variable groups, and service connections.
  
  
Scripting: Proficiency in PowerShell with knowledge of module development patterns, error handling, and Pester testing. Familiarity with Bash is a plus.
  
  
AI Coding Tools: Demonstrated experience using AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily development workflow. Comfortable with prompt engineering and iterating with AI to solve complex problems.
  
  
Security: Understanding of network security, private endpoints, managed identities, certificate management, and secure secrets handling.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**
Experience working in the Wealth Management or Financial Services industry with strong emphasis on compliance and audit requirements.
  
  
Experience with config-driven infrastructure patterns and code generation.
  
  
Familiarity with Windows and Linux container workloads in Kubernetes.
  
  
Experience with F5 XC, NGINX ingress, or similar ingress/load balancing solutions.
  
  
Exposure to monitoring solutions such as Splunk, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  
  
Experience with Git workflows, pre-commit hooks, and branch protection strategies.
  
  
Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305) or HashiCorp Terraform certification are a plus.
  
  
Experience with Terragrunt or similar Terraform workflow tools.
  
  
Track record of contributing to or maintaining AI agent configurations, custom instructions, or team-wide AI tooling standards.
  
  
***About FNZ***
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.4 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
  
  
Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

title: Network Operations Consultant
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Senior technical lead for the SOC and for the PulseAI platform layer. Runs major\-incident response for security and PulseAI platform events, owns the detection\-content and tuning program — including Kubernetes/OpenShift security telemetry — and is L3 for PulseAI platform operations: owns root cause analysis, works platform defects with the Gruve PulseAI engineering team, leads OpenShift cluster lifecycle operations and emergency remediation, acts as vendor engineering liaison for Red Hat, the NVIDIA software stack and third\-party platform vendors, partners with the Network Operations Consultant on infrastructure\-side events, and deputises for the Security Operation Manager.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead technical response on Severity 1/2 security and PulseAI platform incidents until management command engages; own the SLA status cadence (hourly / every 30 minutes on Severity 1\) to customer authorised contacts; hand infrastructure\-side events (network fabric, GPU hardware, storage) to the Network Operations Consultant and stay engaged on cross\-domain incidents.
* Own root cause analysis for PulseAI platform and OpenShift cluster incidents; reproduce and characterise platform defects and route them to Gruve PulseAI product engineering; own the corrective\-action backlog and problem management to eliminate recurring incidents.
* Own the PulseAI platform operations practice: severity classification standards, diagnostic runbooks for the PulseAI and OpenShift layers (control plane, operators, authentication/SSO, RBAC, tenancy and quota enforcement, model\-serving endpoints, observability), Grafana observability standards, alert thresholds for the SLA appendix, and the monitor / remediate / escalate matrix as applied per customer.
* Lead OpenShift cluster lifecycle operations for PulseAI customers — y\-stream upgrades on customer approval within the agreed window of the Red Hat release, operator and platform\-component changes, emergency vulnerability remediation of the cluster and platform — enforcing the pre\-change backup gate, and coordinating node\-pool, GPU driver/firmware and fabric changes with the Network Operations Consultant.
* Own Kubernetes/OpenShift security operations for the engagement: onboarding kube\-audit and workload telemetry into the SIEM, detection content for container attack paths (MITRE ATT\&CK for Containers), Cilium/Hubble and OVN\-Kubernetes flow use cases, admission\-control and image/runtime security posture, and RBAC / service\-account hygiene reviews.
* Act as vendor engineering liaison for the platform stack: Red Hat for OpenShift product defects, NVIDIA for GPU Operator / driver / NVIDIA AI Enterprise (NIM) software issues, and the third\-party platform variant (Rafay, vCluster, vNode, NVIDIA Run:ai, Red Hat OpenShift AI) where restoration is best\-effort with committed vendor escalation.
* Lead customer onboarding technically for the platform layer: deploy and validate OpenShift and PulseAI within the 14\-day Ready\-for\-Install window, configure identity provider federation and initial tenancy structure, onboard the platform to monitoring via the agreed connectivity pattern (outbound collector, site\-to\-site VPN or jump host with just\-in\-time elevation), and complete the platform sections of the countersigned environment validation checklist.
* Own the detection\-content backlog and tuning program; own log\-pipeline integration health with escalation into engineering.
* Approve and execute high\-risk security and platform changes; cross\-train the SOC L1/L2 bench on Kubernetes/OpenShift platform operations; drive shift\-quality audits and post\-incident reviews for the SOC pod.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* 8–11 years with prior senior/lead experience in SOC or 24×7 platform operations and genuine security\-to\-platform cross\-domain fluency.
* Incident command capability; deep SIEM content and query skills.
* Strong Kubernetes/GKE security operations depth — onboarding kube\-audit and workload telemetry, building detection content for container attack paths (MITRE ATT\&CK for Containers), and tuning Cilium/Hubble\-based use cases.
* Deep Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes operations experience in production — multi\-node cluster administration, operators, y/z\-stream upgrades, RBAC, storage and networking, observability stack (Grafana, metrics, logs, alerting), backup/restore of cluster and platform state — with a track record of platform diagnostics and RCA.
* GPU\-cluster platform operations experience: NVIDIA GPU Operator/driver lifecycle, NVIDIA AI Enterprise components (NIM), DCGM\-class telemetry, node health and capacity management for AI inference workloads on RTX PRO 6000 / HGX B300\-class servers or equivalent.
* Experience operating against contractual SLAs (acknowledgement, restoration, availability, service credits) and running vendor engineering escalations through to fix.
* Working network troubleshooting sufficient to scope cluster\-networking versus fabric faults jointly with the NOC; automation mindset.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced incident\-handling / intrusion\-analysis certification (e.g., GCIH, GCIA, GCFA or equivalent).
* CKS or equivalent; experience running K8s posture/runtime security tooling in production.
* Red Hat certifications (EX280 / EX380 / RHCE); exposure to Rafay, vCluster, NVIDIA Run:ai or Red Hat OpenShift AI; MLOps or AI\-platform operations (model\-serving endpoints, GPU scheduling, quota governance).
* Exposure to HashiCorp Vault, SAML 2\.0 SSO federation, and CSI/NFS storage for model artefacts.
* MSSP/managed\-services background; AI\-SOC tooling exposure.
* Correlating GPU\-platform performance anomalies (utilisation, thermal, fabric saturation) with security events to separate abuse, crypto\-mining or misconfiguration from genuine workload load.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

**Role Description**
 The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands\-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical environment.

By maintaining robust, high\-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real\-time global decision\-making, powers enterprise\-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large\-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high\-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth.

* Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise\-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability.
* Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements.
* Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long\-term organizational objectives.


**What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting**
 This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise\-scale data infrastructure.
   

  

 You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large\-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems — while guiding a talented team through complex, high\-impact challenges.
   

  

 With global scope, mission\-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands\-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating.
   

  

**Professional development value of this role**
 Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization \- such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise\-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions.
   

  

**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale, global or multi\-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission\-critical system reliability.


**Qualifications, Experience, Education**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of progressive, hands\-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting.


**Skills**

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a FinOps Engineer with a DevOps backbone who has an almost obsessive eye for cost leaks, idle resources, and inefficiencies across our platform. If unused EBS volumes, oversized instances, or a forgotten dev environment running on weekends genuinely bother you, you'll fit right in. This isn't a passive reporting role. You'll be expected to proactively hunt for waste, propose optimisations, and drive strategic cost conversations with engineering, SRE, and leadership across ZOOP's entire platform from infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters to data pipelines and third\-party services.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Continuously audit ZOOP's cloud footprint (AWS/Azure/GCP) end\-to\-end compute, storage, networking, databases, observability stack, and SaaS tooling and flag every form of waste, big or small.
* Proactively propose cost\-reduction strategies rather than waiting to be asked; bring data, options, trade\-offs, and a recommendation to the table.
* Lead monthly/quarterly cost reviews with engineering and product leadership; turn billing data into actionable conversations.
* Build cost visibility dashboards and chargeback/showback models so every team at ZOOP knows what they're spending and why.
* Drive rightsizing, autoscaling tuning, Spot/Reserved Instance/Savings Plan strategies, and storage tiering across the platform.
* Embed cost guardrails into CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), and Kubernetes manifests to catch wasteful resources before they're deployed.
* Optimise Kubernetes cost efficiency using tools like Kubecost, OpenCost, or Karpenter; tune requests/limits, HPA/VPA, and node pools.
* Set up automated alerts and anomaly detection for budget breaches, idle resources, and runaway costs.
* Partner with Finance for forecasting, unit economics (cost per user/transaction), and cloud budget planning.
* Evangelise a cost\-aware engineering culture, run internal sessions, write playbooks, and make FinOps a shared responsibility, not a finance afterthought.


**Requirements**
* Someone with genuine OCD around cost and wastage; you can't sleep knowing a non\-prod cluster ran all weekend at full capacity.
* A DevOps practitioner first, who understands why costs happen at the infrastructure level, not just someone reading billing reports.
* Naturally proactive; you don't wait for tickets; you spot patterns, dig in, and propose changes before anyone asks.
* Comfortable challenging engineering decisions diplomatically when they're expensive, and equally comfortable defending necessary spend to finance.
* A clear communicator who can talk to both a senior engineer about Karpenter configs and a CFO about quarterly burn.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, SRE, or Cloud FinOps roles.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred), including native cost tools (Cost Explorer, CUR, Azure Cost Management, or GCP Billing).
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi).
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE).
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or Go for automation, reporting, and cost tooling.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD).
* Solid grasp of cloud pricing models: On\-Demand, Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, Spot/Preemptible, committed\-use discounts.
* SQL skills for querying billing data (AWS CUR via Athena/Redshift, BigQuery billing exports).


**Nice To Have**
* FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) certification.
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with FinOps platforms (CloudHealth, Cloudability/Apptio, Spot.io, Vantage, Kubecost).
* Exposure to multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud cost optimisation.
* Understanding of SaaS unit economics (cost per customer, cost per transaction, gross margin impact).


 This job was posted by Malavika Kannoth from ZOOP.
